raw.description:
About ApotheCom

ApotheCom is an exciting leader in the field of medical communications. Drawn together from several backgrounds including the pharmaceutical industry, research, marketing, medical and regulatory writing, sales, publishing, digital media and design, we have the experience and all-round ability to conceive and deliver the best quality medical communications programs.

About the role

The Associate Medical Director is a scientific and strategic lead responsible for the quality, accuracy and strategic direction of assigned medical communications workstreams and accounts.

In this role, you will be accountable for ensuring that scientific content is clinically accurate, strategically aligned, insight-driven and relevant to client medical strategy and agency objectives. You will partner closely with client services, editorial, creative, digital, medical writing and senior scientific leadership to ensure that deliverables meet client expectations, reflect current scientific evidence and support broader communication goals.

The Associate Medical Director serves as a key scientific contact for clients, faculty and external experts, bringing subject matter expertise, sound judgment and a proactive consultative approach to assigned projects. You will lead and contribute to content development plans, elevate the scientific and strategic quality of deliverables, support new business activity and help guide junior scientific team members.

To be considered for this role, candidates should have successfully demonstrated Senior Medical Writer-level capabilities and typically bring at least 5 years of experience in medical communications, publications, medical education or a related scientific communications environment.

The Associate Medical Director will report to a Medical Director, Senior Medical Director or senior Scientific Services leader.

Key responsibilities

Strategic thinking and scientific insight

  • Accountable for the scientific strategy and quality of assigned accounts, workstreams and deliverables, ensuring alignment with client medical strategy and agency objectives.
  • Leads and contributes to content development plans, ensuring deliverables are grounded in evidence and aligned with strategic imperatives.
  • Interprets and synthesizes complex clinical data, including clinical trial results, congress updates, treatment guidelines, publications and competitive information.
  • Translates complex scientific and clinical information into clear, compelling and strategically relevant medical communications.
  • Provides proactive scientific input into publication plans, medical education programs, communication platforms and other client deliverables.
  • Identifies key scientific insights, evidence gaps and communication opportunities that can strengthen client strategy.
  • Participates in new business pitches, proposals and client onboarding by providing scientific insight and therapeutic area expertise.

Client partnership and excellence in delivery

  • Serves as a key scientific contact for clients, faculty, authors, investigators and external experts, building relationships based on scientific credibility, responsiveness and delivery excellence.
  • Partners with pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients to understand goals, communication objectives, scientific priorities and success measures.
  • Reviews and elevates scientific content to ensure not only accuracy, but also strategic alignment with client objectives.
  • Ensures assigned medical communications are clinically relevant, current and reflective of recent advances in the therapeutic area.
  • Liaises with clients and external experts to support streamlined, efficient development of high-quality deliverables.
  • Supports the planning and execution of advisory boards, investigator meetings, faculty meetings, congress activities and scientific workshops.
  • Anticipates client needs, flags risks early and recommends solutions to protect scientific quality, timelines and budget expectations.

Teamwork, collaboration and leadership

  • Partners with Client Services and cross-functional colleagues across creative, digital, editorial, account and specialized services to ensure deliverables meet client expectations.
  • Provides day-to-day scientific direction to medical writers, freelancers and junior scientific team members.
  • Offers formal and informal mentorship, coaching and performance feedback to junior team members, supporting their scientific growth and delivery quality.
  • Demonstrates increasing autonomy in account decision-making while knowing when to escalate scientific, client, budget or delivery risks.
  • Proactively drives team growth and efficiency, including suggestions for process improvement within the team, cluster or squad.
  • Contributes to key strategic priorities, including recruitment, resourcing, business development and operational excellence.
  • Collaborates with project and account teams to ensure timelines are realistic, scope is understood and scientific requirements are appropriately planned.

Content development and quality oversight

  • Leads or oversees development of scientific content across manuscripts, abstracts, posters, slide decks, advisory board materials, white papers, monographs, congress materials and medical education content.
  • Reviews and refines medical writing to ensure scientific accuracy, strategic relevance, logical flow, appropriate tone and audience fit.
  • Conducts targeted literature reviews and evidence assessments to ensure content reflects current clinical practice and therapeutic developments.
  • Maintains awareness of good publication practices and appropriate standards for publications, medical education and professional communications.
  • Provides quality control for scientific content developed by internal writers, freelancers and external partners.
  • Ensures reference support, data interpretation, claims and scientific messaging are accurate, balanced and appropriately substantiated.

Financial and operational awareness

  • Understands the financial side of assigned accounts and works with team members to help projects remain in scope.
  • Provides senior scientific input into scopes of work, budgets, timelines and resource planning.
  • Identifies potential changes in project focus, scientific complexity or scope and escalates appropriately.
  • Supports efficient delivery by balancing scientific excellence with timeline, budget and client-service expectations.

About you:

You are an experienced medical communications professional with strong scientific judgment, strategic curiosity and the confidence to advise clients and guide internal teams. You can move fluidly between detailed content review and broader strategic discussion, and you are comfortable taking ownership of complex scientific deliverables.

Experience and capabilities

  • Advanced degree in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, pharmacology or a related scientific discipline; doctorate-level training preferred.
  • Strong experience in medical communications, publications, medical education, scientific strategy or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at or above Senior Medical Writer level, including strong content development, data interpretation and client-facing skills.
  • Strong understanding of clinical data interpretation, publication development, medical education and pharmaceutical communications.
  • Ability to lead scientific content development with limited oversight.
  • Strong client communication skills, including the ability to interact professionally and confidently with clients, faculty and external experts.
  • Experience mentoring, guiding or line-managing medical writers, freelancers or junior scientific team members.
  • Strong organizational, financial and administrative discipline, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and strong commitment to scientific accuracy, quality and compliance.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with literature databases and reference management tools preferred.
  • Ability to travel as needed, including occasional weekends.

ApotheCom can offer an attractive rewards package, excellent training and development opportunities, a supportive and friendly environment and the opportunity to achieve your potential.

Our Pledge

At ApotheCom, we value inclusivity, recognize the power of diversity and inspire the next generation of change-makers. We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity, equity and inclusion. We aim to recruit from a diverse slate of candidates and foster an environment that provides the right conditions for long-term success. We welcome all applications regardless of race, color, religion or belief, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, marital status, military veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation and physical or mental disability.

ApotheCom is part of Inizio Medical. Inizio is a strategic partner for health and life sciences with a full suite of medical, marketing, advisory and engagement services.

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

raw.description:
This is an exciting opportunity for a highly experienced, independent clinical biostatistician to advance adoption of Natera’s oncology portfolio of cutting-edge molecular diagnostic tests. As a Lead Biostatistician, you will independently lead the design, analysis, and reporting for multiple practice-changing oncology clinical trials. You will propose efficient, fit-for-purpose study designs with broad impact across the oncology portfolio.

The ideal candidate brings deep statistical expertise, strong scientific communication skills, and a proven track record of applying innovative methodologies to oncology clinical trial design in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Study Design and Statistical Strategy: Lead the statistical design and analytical planning for oncology clinical utility studies. Provide technical expertise in complex study design methodologies and data analyses. Propose and justify efficient study designs tailored to complex oncology use cases.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as study statistician for multiple studies. Collaborate with clinical, medical, and translational partners to influence study planning, development, and execution. Identify risks, proactively communicate concerns, and champion solutions to interdisciplinary teams and executive leaders.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Author and review high-quality statistical deliverables, including statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and reports (TLFs, CSRs, publications) for cross-functional collaborators and stakeholders.
  • Innovation and Improvement: Recommend and apply novel statistical approaches where appropriate. Mentor early career statisticians and support continuous improvement of departmental processes, tools, and templates to enhance team efficiency and analytical rigor. Collaborate on manuscripts for publications.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Advanced degree in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (Ph.D. preferred).
  • 4+ years of experience in clinical trial biostatistics.
  • Strong expertise in time-to-event analysis, including handling of censoring, competing risks, and advanced survival modeling approaches commonly used in oncology.
  • Expertise with innovative study design (e.g. adaptive and biomarker-informed designs), power calculations, and endpoint evaluation.
  • Working knowledge of ICH and GCP guidelines as well as CDISC standards (e.g. SDTM, ADaM).
  • Proficient in R.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Expert-level ability to independently design clinical studies, grounded in deep domain knowledge and a nuanced understanding of complex, oncology-specific challenges.
  • Experience with biomarker enabled clinical study designs, sample size determination, and endpoint evaluation.
  • Demonstrated ability and enthusiasm for working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments with collaborators from diverse technical backgrounds.
  • Ability to communicate complex statistical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Preferred qualifications:
    • Working-knowledge of NGS-based diagnostics and ctDNA/MRD.
    • Experience with non-inferiority studies.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$130,900—$180,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit .

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. raw.description:
Bridgeway is seeking a Data Engineer (BI) to design, develop, and maintain our data warehouse infrastructure and the semantic models, dashboards, and reporting that sit on top of it. This role involves working closely with analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to shape our data architecture, build secure and efficient data pipelines and curated data models, and turn data into self-service analytics and insight across the organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering, dimensional and semantic data modeling, business intelligence tooling, and ELT processes, along with a passion for making data accessible and actionable.

This is a remote position with occasional travel. Preference given to East Coast candidates.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and maintain semantic data models, metrics layers, and certified datasets that provide a consistent, business-friendly source of truth for reporting and self-service analytics.
  • Define, standardize, and govern KPIs, calculation logic, and a shared metric glossary so that metrics are consistent and trusted across dashboards and self-service analytics.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize dashboards and reports in Sigma (primary), with some Power BI and native Databricks dashboards/AI-BI Genie , and enable business users to explore data through governed self-service analytics.
  • Define and maintain Sigma workspace standards (workbook templates, certified datasets, RLS configuration, naming/governance conventions) in the development instance for promotion across tenant environments, in partnership with Platform Engineering, for tenant-level administration.
  • Collaborate with the Architecture team on data quality, testing, and observability; own triage and resolution of BI-layer/dashboard issues.
  • Drive BI adoption by training and supporting business users, monitoring dashboard usage, and identifying underused or redundant assets for redesign, training, or deprecation.
  • Ensure data security and compliance, including role-based access controls for security, encryption, masking, and governance best practices to ensure compliant handling of sensitive information.
  • Gather reporting and analytics requirements from business stakeholders, define success measures, and translate them into technical specifications and well-structured data products.
  • Enable analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases through well-structured, business-friendly data models, feature availability, and platform integrations using tools such as Databricks Vector Search and Model Serving.
  • Collaborate within an Agile-Scrum framework and develop comprehensive technical design documentation to ensure efficient and successful delivery.
  • Build and maintain production dashboards and workbooks in Sigma, ensuring reliability and performance for business users.
  • Implement row-level security and Entra ID-based access controls to govern and secure data access within the BI/data platform.
  • Collaborate and communicate proactively with engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders, influencing priorities and driving alignment across teams.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of hands-on data engineering and/or business intelligence experience required.
  • Experience in Databricks, including DAB and Materialized Views.
  • 3+ years designing semantic/dimensional data models and building dashboards and reports in a modern BI platform including hands-on experience with a metrics or semantic layer required.
  • 3+ years of experience with analytical SQL (ANSI SQL/T-SQL/Spark SQL) and Python for data engineering, including pipeline construction, transformation logic, and automation required.
  • Azure DevOps; GitHub CoPilot knowledge is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Experience dealing with HIPAA compliant data sets is a plus.

raw.description:
Position: Director of Supply Chain
Department: Supply Chain & Logistics
Employer Company: EAK Distribution
Reports To: COO / Integrator
Job Type: Full Time, Remote
Salary: Up to $4000
Work Hours: 8 AM - 12 PM EST, with flexibility to coordinate with external partners in PST and occasional communication with Chinese suppliers.

Role (Overview of the Position)

The Director of Supply Chain is a senior leadership role responsible for building and managing the end-to-end supply chain infrastructure that will scale HOME GROWN from ~$20M to $100M+ in revenue. This position owns the full physical flow of goods: raw material procurement (domestic and international), vendor management including overseas finished goods suppliers, production coordination with Heirloom Organics, inventory planning and demand forecasting, inbound/outbound logistics, and multi-channel fulfillment across Amazon FBA, TikTok Shop (MCF and FBT), Shopify, Home Depot dropship, and future retail partners.

Reporting to the COO/Integrator, the Director of Supply Chain leads the logistics team, owns the supply chain budget, and serves as the primary driver of ERP selection and implementation. This role must build the systems, processes, and team capable of supporting 600+ SKUs within two years while maintaining a stockout rate below 1%.

This is not a maintenance role. The company is in a high-growth phase with expanding channels, a vertically integrated manufacturing facility, and plans to 5x revenue. The Director of Supply Chain must be someone who has built supply chain infrastructure at scale and thrives in environments where the playbook has not been written yet.

Responsibilities (Tasks Associated with the Role)

Demand Planning & Inventory Strategy

  • Own the demand planning function across all channels and all SKUs (180 today, scaling to 600+ within two years).
  • Build and maintain rolling demand forecasts that integrate sales velocity, seasonality, promotional calendars, and channel expansion timelines.
  • Maintain a stockout rate below 1% across all active SKUs while minimizing overstock and dead inventory.
  • Establish safety stock models, reorder points, and lead time buffers for each product category and channel.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Brand Management, andProduct Development to align forecasts with planned launches, promotions, and channel expansions.

Procurement & Vendor Management

  • Consolidate and own all procurement across entities: raw seeds (via Heirloom Organics), envelopes, mylars, soil, pots, packaging materials, and finished goods from overseas and domestic suppliers.
  • Manage international supplier relationships including overseas finished goods vendors: lead times, import logistics, customs/duties, and quality assurance.
  • Negotiate supplier contracts, pricing, lead times, and quality standards.
  • Build a diversified vendor base that reduces single-source risk as SKU count scales.

Heirloom Organics Production Coordination

  • Serve as the primary supply chain interface with Mark (Operations Lead) and the Heirloom Organics team in Grants Pass, OR.
  • Translate demand forecasts into production requirements and ensure production schedules align with fulfillment timelines.
  • Track production output against commitments. Escalate and problem-solve when production falls behind plan.
  • Collaborate on capacity planning as SKU count and volume grow, including equipment utilization (seed counters, bag packers, labeling lines).

Logistics & Fulfillment

  • Oversee all inbound freight (vendor to warehouse/FBA/FBT) and outbound fulfillment operations.
  • Manage Amazon FBA compliance: IPI score maintenance (450+), restock limits, stranded inventory resolution, shipment plan optimization.
  • Manage TikTok Shop fulfillment across both Amazon MCF and Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT), including inventory allocation to TikTok warehouses.
  • Optimize B2C direct-to-consumer fulfillment for Shopify and TikTok orders. Determine when orders should ship from 3PL, Heirloom Organics directly, or FBA/FBT. Specifically optimize multi-unit order fulfillment to reduce per-unit shipping costs.
  • Oversee Home Depot dropship fulfillment and future retail channel logistics.
  • Optimize freight costs, carrier relationships, and shipping workflows.
  • Manage 3PL relationships and evaluate when direct fulfillment from HO is more cost-effective.

ERP Selection & Implementation

  • Lead the supply chain workstream of ERP evaluation and selection (currently in evaluation phase).
  • Define requirements for inventory management, procurement, production planning, and order management modules.
  • Own the supply chain side of ERP implementation: data migration, workflow configuration, team training, and go-live execution.
  • Ensure the ERP delivers real-time inventory visibility across all entities and channels.

Budget & Cost Management

  • Own the full supply chain budget: freight, raw materials, packaging, 3PL costs, and logistics overhead.
  • Track spend against budget with no more than +/-5% variance.
  • Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities across freight, procurement, and fulfillment without compromising service levels.
  • Report on supply chain unit economics and COGS trends to the COO and Controller.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Directly manage Asad (Logistics Manager) and Faiqa (Logistics Analyst).
  • Provide oversight and evaluation of Ather (Logistics Coordinator) and Faisal to assess fit and readiness for scale.
  • Assess the current team structure and capabilities against the requirements of a 600+ SKU, $100M operation. Identify gaps and build a hiring plan.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with all direct reports. Establish clear KPIs and accountability for each role.
  • Foster a culture of operational discipline, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement.

Results (Expected Accomplishments)

Inventory & Availability

  • Maintain stockout rate below 1% across all active SKUs and channels.
  • Achieve demand forecast accuracy of 85%+ within the first 12 months.
  • Maintain Amazon IPI score at 450+ consistently.
  • Establish forward visibility of 8+ weeks on potential stockouts.

Procurement & Cost

  • Consolidate all procurement under a single function within the first 90 days.
  • Maintain or improve COGS as a percentage of revenue versus prior year.
  • Maintain supply chain budget within +/-5% variance.

Systems & Infrastructure

  • Complete ERP evaluation and selection within the first 90 days.
  • Lead supply chain ERP implementation to go-live.
  • Deliver real-time inventory visibility across all entities and channels.

Heirloom Organics Alignment

  • Establish a weekly production alignment cadence with Heirloom Organics within the first 30 days.
  • Achieve 90%+ production schedule adherence against demand-driven production plans.

Team & Operational Readiness

  • Complete a team assessment within 60 days: document capabilities, gaps, and a hiring/development plan for scaling to 600+ SKUs.
  • 100% of direct reports have documented roles (4R documents), clear KPIs, and weekly 1:1s.
  • Fulfillment SLA compliance at 98%+ across all channels.

Requirements (Expected Proficiencies)

Experience

  • 7+ years in supply chain, logistics, or operations management with at least 3 years in a senior/director-level role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing supply chains with hundreds of SKUs and complex raw material inputs (e-commerce or CPG strongly preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience scaling supply chain infrastructure from ~$20M to $50M+ in revenue.
  • Track record of managing end-to-end supply chains: raw material procurement, finished goods sourcing (including international/overseas suppliers), inventory planning, fulfillment, and logistics.
  • Experience selecting and implementing ERP or inventory management systems.
  • Experience managing or closely coordinating with manufacturing/production operations.

Skills

  • Strong demand planning and inventory optimization capabilities. Comfortable building forecast models and safety stock frameworks.
  • Deep understanding of Amazon FBA operations: IPI management, restock limits, shipment planning, and stranded inventory.
  • Proficiency with supply chain analytics and reporting. Able to translate complex logistics data into clear leadership updates.
  • Vendor negotiation and contract management.
  • ERP/WMS/IMS fluency. Ability to define requirements, evaluate vendors, and lead implementation.
  • Budget ownership and P&L management experience.

Leadership & Communication

  • Proven ability to build, assess, and develop logistics teams. Not just managing what is inherited, but evaluating talent for scale readiness and making hard calls.
  • Ability to influence cross-functionally, including production teams without a direct reporting line.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. Can operate effectively in a remote-first, async-heavy environment.
  • Systems thinker who can zoom out from daily execution to identify structural risks and build for scale.

Cultural Fit

  • Aligned with HOME GROWN core values: Radical Transparency, Disciplined Growth, Compounded Trust, Measured Decisions, Intentional Execution, Collective Excellence.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments where processes are being built, not maintained.
  • Comfortable with EOS methodology (L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, Accountability Charts).
  • Self-directed and accountable. Does not require micromanagement to deliver results.

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talents with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and AI.

Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Job Summary

As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. You will work closely with data analysts, data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure reliable, accessible, and high-quality data across the organization.

This is an excellent opportunity for professionals who enjoy solving complex data challenges and building systems that support business intelligence, analytics, and machine learning initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL and ELT pipelines.
  • Build and optimize data architectures, databases, and data warehouses.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, APIs, and third-party platforms.
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, reliability, and security.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and workflows.
  • Collaborate with analytics, engineering, and business teams to understand data requirements.
  • Implement data governance and best practices for data management.
  • Optimize data storage, processing performance, and query efficiency.
  • Support reporting, business intelligence, and analytics initiatives.
  • Document data models, workflows, and technical processes.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or related roles.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and database management.
  • Experience with Python, Java, Scala, or similar programming languages.
  • Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT tools and data pipeline development.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with modern data warehouses such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or Databricks.
  • Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Prefect.
  • Understanding of data modeling, data governance, and data quality principles.
  • Experience working with large datasets and distributed systems is preferred.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, collaborative environment.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and location.

🌎 Fully remote role: Work from anywhere with flexible working arrangements.

🚀 Career growth opportunities: Join innovative companies and work on impactful projects.

📈 Long-term opportunities: Build your career with growing global organizations.

🧠 Continuous learning: Exposure to modern data technologies, cloud platforms, and large-scale data systems.

🤝 Collaborative culture: Work alongside talented engineers, analysts, and business leaders.

⚙️ Cutting-edge technology: Gain experience with modern data stacks and cloud-native solutions.

The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary


Lead delivery of employee facing IT services that keep the workforce productive across a global enterprise including: Service Desk, Onsite Support, and Access Management. This role leads a blended team of employees and strategic supplier resources responsible for reliable IT services. The Manager, End User Services sets service standards, governs operational excellence of delivery partners, manages escalations, VIP support, and builds strong partnerships within IT and the business to design a positive technology experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop an internal team of service delivery professionals
  • Govern delivery partner accountability, performance, and service transformation
  • Develop customer-centric service roadmaps, forecasts, and lifecycle planning
  • Oversee daily operations across service portfolio, escalation resolution, and root cause analysis
  • Ensure access control compliance in partnership with internal and external audit
  • Build influential partnerships with business leaders, VIP, technical teams, and vendors

Skills and Background You'll Need


Education:Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Computer Science, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience in global IT service delivery, end user support, or digital workplace services including: service desk, onsite support, access management, and IT depot.

  • 5+ years establishing and governing vendor performance through service agreements, SLAs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • 3+ years people leadership experience, including coaching, developing, and managing technical teams.
  • Experience creating service strategies, roadmaps, budgets, and operational plans.
  • Strong empathic communication and relationship management skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology teams.
  • Availability for occasional domestic and international travel
  • ITIL, identity, or security certification preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability operating in a regulated industry supporting IT control frameworks preferred.

Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate


  • Developing People: Builds inclusive, high-performing teams through coaching, feedback, and career development.
  • Winning Together: Fosters strong partnerships across teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes.
  • Driving Success: Takes accountability for service performance, customer experience, and delivering measurable business value.
  • Strategic Visioning: Translates business and technology priorities into long-term service roadmaps and operational improvements.
  • Adaptability: Sees possibilities in changing circumstances, accepts and understands change, and adjusts quickly to changing priorities while maintaining focus on business objectives.

Why Join The Standard?

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

  • A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

  • An annual incentive bonus plan

  • Generous paid time off including 11 holidays, 2 wellness days, and 8 volunteer hours annually — PTO increases with tenure

  • A supportive, responsive management approach and opportunities for career growth and advancement

  • Paid parental leave and adoption/surrogacy assistance

  • An employee giving program that double matches your donations to eligible nonprofits and schools

In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee-focused benefits support work-life balance. Learn more about working at The Standard.

  • Eligibility to participate in an incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program and plan. Any award depends on a variety of factors including individual and organizational performance.

The actual compensation for this role will be based on a combination of education and experience, knowledge and skills, position budget, internal equity, and market data.

Salary Range:

$97,750.00 - $186,000.00

Positions will be posted for at least 5 days from original posting date.

Standard Insurance Company, The Standard Life Insurance Company of New York, Standard Retirement Services, Inc., StanCorp Mortgage Investors, LLC, StanCorp Investment Advisers, Inc., and American Heritage Life Insurance Company and American Heritage Service Company, marketed as The Standard, are Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability or veteran status or any other condition protected by federal, state or local law. Except where precluded by state or federal law, The Standard will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. The Standard offers a drug- and alcohol-free work environment where possession, manufacture, transfer, offer, use of or being impaired by an illegal substance while on The Standard's property, or in other cases which the company believes might affect operations, safety or reputation of the company is prohibited. The Standard requires a criminal background investigation and employment, education and licensing verification as a condition of employment. After any conditional offer of employment is made, the background check will include an individualized assessment based on the applicant’s specific record and the duties and requirements of the specific job. Applicants will be provided an opportunity to explain and correct background information. All employees of The Standard must be bondable.

今回のプロジェクトの主な目的は、AIデータの開発と拡張です。
品質評価者は、プロジェクトのルールや決まりに基づいた、広告の主観的および客観的な評価を担当します。インターネット検索の最前線に身を置き、業界を牽引しませんか？

プロジェクトの詳細

職名:ウェブ検索結果品質評価者
仕事内容:ウェブ検索結果の品質向上のため、表示された検索結果の評価、そしてフィードバックの送信（タスクは主に日本語ですが、英語の評価内容もあります）
タスクはアサインされることはなく、ご自身の都合がよい時間や、スキマ時間にツールにログインしていただき、タスクをご自身で行っていただく形式となります。一週間にどれくらい働いたかなどもご自身での管理をお願いいたします。実際に行われたタスクは評価ツールに記録され、それに基づきお支払いが送られてきます。

勤務時間: 週5～20時間、ご自身でスケジュール調整可（繁忙期、閑散期あり）

週ごとに勤務時間が変動する可能性があるため、ご了承の程お願いいたします。

要件

  • ネイティブレベルの日本語力
  • 高い英語力
  • 日本のポップカルチャーへの深い理解
  • Ads Quality Rater/広告品質評価者”として現在働いていない方、または過去に働いた経験が無い方

  • 優れたオンラインリサーチ技術
  • 信頼性の高いコンピューターシステムと安定したインターネット環境
  • 強固なウイルス対策ソフト（業務の中でウェブ検索を実施するため）
  • 英語の指示に従い、クライアント指定の決まりとルールを遵守できる能力
  • クライアントの機密を保護するための機密保持契約書への署名
  • 言語力テスト、学習プログラム、クライアント指定の品質テストへの合格（業務開始前に実施）

採用プロセス

  • ① 応募・書類選考: キャリアページよりご応募いただき、プロジェクトに関する簡単な質問にご回答いただきます。

  • ③ スキル・語学評価: 語学力および技術スキルを確認するための簡単なテストを受けていただきます。
  • ④ プロジェクトガイダンス: 専用の「Know-How」ガイドやプロジェクト資料をご確認いただき、業務開始に向けた準備を行っていただきます。
  • ⑤ クライアント試験: 実際のプロジェクトに参加する前に、クライアントによる適性確認テストを受験していただきます。
  • ⑥ オンボーディング・業務開始: 本人確認（IDおよび税務情報の確認）が完了後、正式にオンボーディングとなります。ご自身でスケジュールを設定し、業務を開始していただけます。

raw.excerpt: About Revolution Space At Revolution Space we're building advanced space systems for the 21st century.
raw.description:
About Revolution Space

At Revolution Space we're building advanced space systems for the 21st century. Every employee at Revolution Space works on projects that are critical to our company’s future by ensuring our products work on orbit every time.

Position Summary:

Revolution Space is looking for a dynamic and growth-oriented Senior Configuration Management Analyst who will be responsible for owning the integrity of our product data and the configuration change control process as we design, build, and fly hardware. You’ll be the backbone of how engineering configuration changes flow from design to production, administering our Arena PLM system by enforcing configuration control disciplines. To ensure every team from engineering to manufacturing to quality is working from the same source of truth.

This role is ideal for someone who is detail-obsessed, comfortable working across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing and quality, and who takes pride in a clean, audit-ready bill of materials and coordinating engineering review board and configuration control board meetings.

The position is: Remote with a 25% travel requirement.

Responsibilities:

  • Own configuration control in Arena PLM; administer item masters, BOMs, revisions, lifecycle phases, and change objects (ECOs/ECRs/deviations) to ensure accuracy and traceability across product lifecycles
  • Manage the document change process; process, route, and track engineering change requests/orders through review and approval, coordinating with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain stakeholders
  • Maintain data integrity; audit part numbers, revisions, and BOM structures for accuracy, consistency, and completeness; resolve discrepancies before they become build or quality issues
  • Support the Engineering Review Board (ERB) and Configuration Control Board (CCB) meetings; prepare document packages, track action items, publish meeting minutes, and maintain change log.
  • Enforce configuration management best practices; develop and maintain CM procedures, work instructions, and naming/numbering conventions aligned with industry standards (e.g., AS9100)
  • Enable traceability; support as-designed, as-built, and as-flown configuration baselines, especially for flight and safety-critical hardware
  • Partner cross functionally; train and support engineers, buyers, and production staff on Arena workflows and CM processes; act as the go-to resource for PLM questions
  • Support audits; prepare configuration and change records for internal audits, customer reviews, and regulatory/compliance inspections

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in configuration management, engineering data management, or a related PLM/document control role
  • Bachelors degree in engineering, technical discipline, or equivalent
  • Hands-on experience administering Arena PLM with willingness to become an Arena power user quickly
  • Solid understanding of configuration management principles: BOM structures, revision control, change control processes, and lifecycle management
  • Familiarity with CM standards and practices
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working with data at scale
  • Ability to communicate clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders, and to hold the line on process discipline without becoming a bottleneck Describe the required experience and attributes of the ideal candidate

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hardware/aerospace startup environment strongly preferred
  • Experience with data migrations or system implementations (e.g., standing up or reconfiguring PLM system)
  • Exposure to ERP/MRP systems and how they interfere with PLM
  • Familiarity with drawing/model-based definition practices
  • Prior experience in satellite, launch vehicle, or space hardware programs

Benefits

  • Paid holidays, sick time and unmetered vacation
  • Excellent health and dental plans with 80% employer contribution
  • 4% company matching 401k plan with immediate vesting
  • Life insurance
  • Voluntary Long term / Short term disability

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicants must be U.S. citizens, lawful permanents residents of the U.S., or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other protected factor.

raw.description:
Automation Specialist – Remote | Cape Town

Location: Cape Town, Western Cape
Working Arrangement: Remote
Salary: R25,000 per month
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for a technically capable and hands-on Automation Specialist to join a growing, digitally focused business.

This is a remote position, but applicants must be based in Cape Town.

The successful candidate will be responsible for building, managing and improving business automation workflows, with a particularly strong focus on WhatsApp bots and WhatsApp-based automation.

This role would suit someone who enjoys finding ways to remove repetitive manual processes, connecting different platforms and building reliable automated workflows that improve customer engagement and internal efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain automated business workflows.
  • Build, configure and manage WhatsApp bots and WhatsApp automation.
  • Develop automated customer communication and engagement journeys.
  • Integrate WhatsApp with CRM, lead management and other business systems.
  • Create automated workflows between different applications and platforms.
  • Map existing manual processes and identify opportunities for automation.
  • Build triggers, actions, routing rules and automated notifications.
  • Troubleshoot failed automations, integration issues and workflow errors.
  • Test new workflows thoroughly before implementation.
  • Monitor existing automations and continuously improve performance and reliability.
  • Maintain clear documentation of automation processes and integrations.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to understand operational requirements and translate them into practical automation solutions.
  • Assist with the implementation and optimisation of new automation tools and technologies.
  • Ensure customer data is handled accurately and securely throughout automated processes.

Essential Requirements

Applicants must have:

  • Proven hands-on experience working in automation, workflow automation or business process automation.
  • Practical experience building and managing WhatsApp bots or WhatsApp automation – non-negotiable.
  • Experience integrating WhatsApp with other systems, platforms or workflows.
  • Strong understanding of triggers, workflows, APIs, webhooks and system integrations.
  • Experience with automation/integration platforms or comparable technologies.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve automation and integration problems independently.
  • Strong technical problem-solving ability.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must currently be based in Cape Town.

Advantageous Experience

Experience with any of the following would be beneficial:

  • WhatsApp Business Platform / WhatsApp Business API.
  • Chatbot development and conversational automation.
  • CRM automation.
  • Lead-generation and lead-nurturing workflows.
  • API and webhook integrations.
  • No-code or low-code automation platforms such as Make, Zapier or n8n.
  • AI-powered workflow or chatbot automation.
  • Automated sales and customer-service processes.
  • Marketing automation.
  • Database or spreadsheet integrations.

Ideal Candidate

You are practical, technically curious and comfortable getting hands-on with automation tools. You don't simply understand automation conceptually — you have actually built workflows and WhatsApp bots that are used in a real business environment.

You are able to understand a business problem, determine where automation can improve the process, build the solution and troubleshoot it when something goes wrong.

You are organised, self-motivated and comfortable working remotely while taking ownership of your responsibilities.

Non-Negotiables

Please only apply if you:

  • Are currently based in Cape Town.
  • Have genuine hands-on WhatsApp bot / WhatsApp automation experience.
  • Have practical workflow or process automation experience.
  • Are comfortable working independently in a remote role.

Salary: R25,000 per month.

OUR MISSIONAt Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

ABOUT US
Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

CORE VALUES

One Team. One Redwood

Make Your Own Weather

Obsess over Customer Success
Work the Problem
Be Curious
Own the Outcome

Respect Each Other

YOUR IMPACT

As a Software Engineer – Principal, IBM i (AS/400) Connectivity, you will help build a new connectivity agent that extends Redwood RunMyJobs (RMJ) natively onto IBM i (AS/400), enabling Redwood to support some of the largest enterprise automation environments in the market. You will join a small, senior team building this capability largely from first principles, validating assumptions on live IBM i partitions and making architectural decisions where modern documentation may be limited. This position is open across levels from Software Engineer to Principal as we build out the team.

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain native software supporting connectivity and integration with IBM i (AS/400) environments.
  • Build native job submission and monitoring, spool file and message/data queue handling, and CL/RPG program invocation capabilities.
  • Integrate IBM i functionality with the Redwood platform through clean, versioned extension points using native host server APIs and/or IBM Toolbox for Java (JTOpen/jt400).
  • Integrate security and per-user authorization using IBM i user profiles and authority concepts while extending Redwood’s existing identity and credential management capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across IBM i, Unix, and Java environments.
  • Improve the reliability, performance, security, and scalability of Redwood’s IBM i solutions.
  • Partner with product managers, architects, and engineers to translate customer requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, testing, and release planning.
  • Leverage agentic AI to accelerate implementation, testing, and documentation while independently verifying correctness against authoritative IBM i references.
  • Document connector behavior and platform prerequisites for field and support teams.
  • Contribute to team success through clear communication, shared responsibility for quality, and accountable ownership of goals and delivery commitments in a fast-paced, iterative agile environment.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong Java 8+ skills.
  • Hands-on IBM i (AS/400) integration experience, including CL, native job/spool/queue APIs, IBM Toolbox for Java (JTOpen/jt400), and DB2 for i.
  • Working proficiency in C, including ILE C on IBM i.
  • Experience integrating with vendor host-server or RPC-style APIs over TCP/IP, including connection lifecycle management and error handling.
  • Strong concurrency and multithreading skills, with experience building resilient, long-running monitoring components such as job polling and spool/file event detection.
  • Ability to work effectively from primary technical sources, including IBM i host-server and API references, rather than relying solely on tutorials or unverified AI-generated output.
  • Experience with modern DevOps practices and technologies, including Git, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Fluency with AI tools in a production engineering environment.
  • Strong code judgment, including the ability to identify plausible but incorrect AI-generated recommendations involving specialized IBM i APIs.
  • Proficiency in prompting AI tools, combined with the judgment to recognize when a task is too specialized for AI-assisted approaches.
  • Ability to maintain an architectural focus, abstracting from individual API and connector details to shared platform-integration designs.
  • Experience with workload automation products such as Tidal, CA-7, Control-M, Stonebranch, BMC, or RunMyJobs preferred.
  • Experience with IBM i clustering or high-availability configurations preferred.
  • Familiarity with advanced IBM i security concepts, including authorization lists and adopted authority, preferred.
  • Background working with RPG/COBOL environments or IBM i modernization projects preferred.
  • Mainframe or midrange migration project experience preferred.

If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

raw.description:
🌟 Exciting Remote Opportunity! We're Hiring an AI Operations & Systems Architect! 🌟

Are you an operational builder and AI systems architect who excels at untangling complex funnels, building custom automations, and deploying pragmatic AI agents? We are seeking an AI Operations & Systems Architect based in LATAM or South Africa to sit directly beside the Founder & CEO of a fast-growing, high-volume investment property lending firm!

🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 🔗

🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH.

📋 Job Details at a Glance

  • Job Title: AI Operations & Systems Architect ("Ops Savage" / AI Systems Builder)

  • Job ID: ARSBEN1EA

  • Industry: Business-Purpose Investment Property Lending (DSCR, RTL, Fix-and-Flip, Bridge)

  • Location: LATAM / South Africa

  • Job Status: Full Time

  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (PST) (Flexible)

  • Salary: $2,800 – $3,200 USD / month 💰

  • Target Start Date: ASAP 🚀

🏢 About the Client

Our client is a fast-growing, high-volume investment property lending firm specializing in business-purpose real estate loans. Having generated ~$45M in year-to-date loan volume, backend operations are currently capped at 15 deals per month due to manual processes. Leadership has intentionally paused outward marketing to build a scalable operational foundation that can handle 50 deals per month ($100M+ volume) without adding redundant headcount.

💼 About the Role

Forget the traditional Executive Assistant or "AI prompter" mental model. You will act as a systems architect and operational implementer—mapping our full customer journey (lead → sales → setup → processing → closing → funding), pinpointing where data leaks out, and building the tools, automations, and grounded AI agents that close those gaps.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

  • 🔍 Days 1–30 Focus (Funnel Visibility): Map the current workflow across sales, processing, and closing; audit CRM/LOS platforms and ad attribution to fix data breakdowns so marketing can safely restart.

  • ⚙️ Scalable Operations & Product Building: Redesign infrastructure to support a 3x deal growth (15 to 50 deals/month); prototype internal tools/interfaces using low-code/no-code, APIs, webhooks, and AI-assisted environments (Lovable, Open Code).

  • 🧠 Company Knowledge Base & "Company Brain": Build a centralized, searchable database of lender guidelines, rate sheets, overlays, and checklists for human staff and AI agents.

  • 🔄 Departmental Optimization & Handoffs: Clean CRM data (Close), automate lead scoring, build sizing/pricing tools, standardize qualification gates between sales/setup/processing, and develop internal condition-clearing copilots.

  • 📊 Lender Matching & Deal-Health Intelligence: Architect dynamic lender-matching logic (top 3–5 lenders per transaction) and real-time deal-health dashboards to predict closing probability.

  • 🤖 Pragmatic AI Agent Deployment: Incrementally build and deploy grounded AI agents (intake, guideline research, pricing copilots, condition clearing) with strict human-in-the-loop approvals.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Core Requirements:

We are a high-performance team built around ownership, responsiveness, and continuous improvement. The Executive Assistant will play a critical role in stabilizing and scaling the CEO’s day-to-day operations, acting as his “functioning memory,” improving written communication quality, and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks.

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support. You will own core operational processes, manage communication systems, coordinate recruiting pipelines, and help implement tools and SOPs that reduce cognitive load for the CEO and leadership team.

This is a full-time, remote position requiring exceptional written communication, strong follow-through, comfort with sensitive information, and the ability to proactively manage both professional and limited personal tasks.

Job Type: Full-Time

Salary: $800 - $1,600 per month (based on experience)

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience supporting senior executives as an EA, Operations Coordinator, or similar role.

  • Able to handle confidential and sensitive information responsibly.
  • Tech-comfortable and adaptable to evolving systems and tools.

Email & Communication Management

    • Manage and organize three inboxes (personal, work, shared investor inbox).
    • Implement follow-up systems to prevent missed replies and recurring “email bankruptcy.”
    • Draft routine and logistical emails for CEO review, reducing workload while preserving control.

Meeting & Calendar Coordination

    • Coordinate weekly and bi-weekly internal meetings (all-hands, leadership, C-suite).

Process Optimization & SOPs:

Task Delegation & Tracking

    • Manage delegated tasks and ensure timely follow-up using Linear.
    • Close feedback loops and prevent lost action items.
    • Support the rollout of structured task and delegation systems across the organization.
    • Assist with daily reminders, priorities, and workload balancing.

Operational & Personal Support

    • Manage operational tasks such as office lunch orders, events, offsites, and travel coordination.
    • Assist with personal scheduling, including medical appointments on recurring cycles.
    • Handle sensitive information in compliance with HIPAA and related agreements.
    • Support monthly outreach to patients with high NPS scores and assist with review collection workflows.
    • Research and implement tools for reviews, CRM, and process optimization.

Systems & Tools

    • Communicate daily via Slack with structured updates.
    • Track tasks and delegation in Linear.

The Senior Revenue Operations Specialist is the internal owner of RCX Sports’ Salesforce environment and a key partner across Sales/Growth, League Success, Marketing, Technology, Customer Service, Finance, and Analytics. This role leads the transition of revenue operations work from external vendors to internal ownership, manages Salesforce administration and governance, improves data integrity, and builds the processes and automations that support sustainable participation and revenue growth.

Reporting to the Director of Analytics, this individual will combine hands-on Salesforce expertise with strong cross-functional partnerships. They will own the Salesforce request queue, release management, access and licensing, platform documentation, and CRM-side integrations, and will play a critical role in implementing a marketing automation platform, serving as the Salesforce and data lead alongside Marketing and Technology.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Serve as RCX Sports’ internal Salesforce administrator and system owner, managing configuration, objects, fields, page layouts, permission sets, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and release management.
  • Manage the Salesforce request queue across business teams, establishing clear intake, prioritization, communication, and turnaround expectations.
  • Build and test changes in sandbox environments and maintain a disciplined, documented deployment process.
  • Lead the transition of revenue operations work from external vendors to internal ownership, including structured knowledge transfer and documentation of workflows, automations, email templates, custom objects, field definitions, and integration logic.
  • Manage user provisioning and deprovisioning, access governance, permissions, licenses, storage, and platform capacity.
  • Improve Salesforce data integrity through deduplication, record hygiene, field standardization, required-field governance, and reconciliation across connected systems.
  • Own the mapping and maintenance of data flowing into Salesforce, partnering with Technology on integration design and troubleshooting.
  • Serve as the CRM-side owner for the marketing automation platform, including object and field mapping, lead and contact synchronization, matching and deduplication rules, consent and suppression handling, and campaign-to-opportunity attribution.
  • Build and maintain revenue workflows and automations, including renewal and end-of-season prompts, onboarding milestones, lead routing, lead scoring, and standardized web-to-lead capture.
  • Identify manual processes across revenue teams and implement scalable solutions that return time to the business.
  • Use Salesforce pipelines, dashboards, and reports to surface operational insights that help customer-facing teams prioritize their efforts and remove bottlenecks.
  • Maintain living documentation of Salesforce workflows, objects, fields, integrations, and dependencies.
  • Partner with Analytics to establish certified metric definitions so Salesforce data aligns with company dashboards and reporting.
  • Evaluate downstream reporting and data-governance impacts before approving or deploying platform changes.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 5+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, Salesforce administration, or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of experience serving as the primary owner of a Salesforce environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Flow, validation rules, custom objects, permission sets, reports, and dashboards.
  • Demonstrated experience improving data integrity through deduplication, record hygiene, field standardization, and reconciliation across systems.
  • Experience managing Salesforce integrations with external systems and partnering with technical teams on APIs, middleware, and data mapping.
  • Experience using sandbox environments and following structured testing, release, and change-management practices.
  • Working knowledge of email and SMS consent requirements, including CAN-SPAM and TCPA, and sound judgment when handling personal data.
  • Strong documentation, organization, and project-management skills.
  • Ability to explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders and translate business needs into scalable system solutions.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate incomplete documentation, lead a vendor transition, and establish effective intake and prioritization practices.
  • A collaborative mindset and an understanding of shared platform ownership across Revenue Operations, Marketing, Technology, and Analytics.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience enabling AI capabilities within CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or AI-assisted workflows).

raw.description:
Who We Are

Chomps is America’s fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors. Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each Chomps meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG. Seasoned with a blend of flavorful herbs and spices, Chomps provides a nutritious protein snack for the whole family. As a minority-owned, family-operated, and B Corporation-certified business, Chomps prioritizes thoughtful sourcing and recently earned the non–ultra-processed food certification through the non-GMO project. Discover a new standard in snacking at www.chomps.com.

Traits of a Chompian

If you’ve been called nimble, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just be a Chompian. You’re a team player who’s self-motivated and action-oriented. You’re committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You’re a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data. You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you’ll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You’re hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you? Then we want to meat you.

*Accepting applications through 10/4/2026 5pm CST

What You Will Do

We seek a highly strategic, deeply organized Senior Project Manager to lead our complex, cross‑category innovation and commercialization initiatives. The ideal candidate brings advanced project leadership experience who does not only monitor progress and manage timelines, budgets, and risks, but also shaping project strategy, driving cross‑functional alignment, and anticipating challenges before they surface. As a Senior Project Manager, you will oversee and influence multiple high‑impact projects through the Stage‑Gate process, ensuring disciplined execution, stakeholder confidence, and consistent on‑time delivery across a fast‑moving innovation pipeline.

Responsibilities

Strategic Project Leadership

  • Lead and influence cross‑functional teams through complex, innovation projects, overseeing multiple high‑move initiatives simultaneously while driving alignment, strategic prioritization, and timely decision‑making to ensure disciplined execution.
  • Build strategic project frameworks, challenge assumptions, and proactively identify risks and bottlenecks before they impact timelines.
  • Drive accountability across teams and elevate issues to leadership when needed to protect launch timing and quality.

Project Management Responsibilities

  • Lead and influence high‑level, cross‑functional project meetings, driving clarity on updates, risks, decisions, and timelines while ensuring alignment across diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Design, refine, and lead the complex project timelines (Monday.com), driving strategic prioritization, anticipating timeline risks, and enabling cross‑functional teams to execute with clarity and precision.
  • Oversee end‑to‑end project performance, using advanced documentation, risk modeling, and mitigation strategies to anticipate issues before they impact delivery.
  • Drive accountability at all levels, ensuring cross‑functional partners meet commitments and escalating barriers early to protect launch timing and quality.
  • Orchestrate cross‑functional collaboration, aligning teams around clear objectives, decision pathways, and commercialization requirements for high moving innovation projects.
  • Manage project scope, budgets, and resources effectively to ensure successful on- time project delivery
  • Coach, mentor, and elevate project managers and commercialization team members, strengthening Stage‑Gate discipline, operational rigor, and project management excellence across the organization.

Stage-Gate Process:

  • Support projects through the stage gate process, assisting in ensuring adherence to defined gates and deliverables at each stage.
  • Partner with the Innovation Director in preparing for gate reviews, including gathering necessary documentation, helping with presentations, taking detailed notesand supporting the documentation of the approvals.
  • Collaborate with the Innovation Director to make sure the key stakeholders are aligned and facilitate decision-making at each gate.
  • Provide training on stage gate and commercialization to new team members​
  • Implement robust post launch evaluations to capture learnings and drive continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Facilitate collaboration across product development, marketing, manufacturing, planning, inventory, fulfillment, BAT, sales, and finance.
  • Promote clear communication and teamwork to manage interdependencies and address conflicts.
  • Serve as the senior liaison between project teams and leadership, providing clear, concise updates on risks, opportunities, and strategic decisions.

Resource Management:

  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to secure the right resources at the right time for complex innovation projects.
  • Prioritize work across teams to optimize efficiency and ensure critical path tasks stay on track

Continuous Improvement:

  • Analyze project data to identify trends, productivity opportunities, and systemic improvements and apply key learnings to drive actionable insights that enhance productivity savings.
  • Champion a culture of learning, cross training, and process optimization.
  • Lead initiatives that strengthen commercialization discipline across the organization.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, project management, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
  • 5-8 years experience as a Project Manager, preferably in the consumer-packaged goods (CPG) industry.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross functional projects with high ambiguity and high visibility.
  • Expert in project management methodologies, risk mitigation, and strategic prioritization.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficient in using project management software and collaboration tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
  • Exceptional communicator with strong executive presence and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Ability to thrive in a team-oriented environment by building relationships , driving alignment , fostering collaboration and driving results with diverse teams
  • People manager experience preferred
  • PMP certification or equivalent is a plus.
  • Project managed in remote environment, preferred

Position: Senior Project Manager, Commercialization

Reports to: Director, Commercialization Operations

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time, exempt

Salary Range Opportunity:

  • The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $150,000 + 20% annual bonus

Compensation Philosophy & Total Comp:

  • Our salary ranges are based on verified market data and our philosophy of paying competitively for our size and industry.
  • Individual pay rate decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.
  • In addition to base salary, full-time team members receive medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K 6% match, and monthly reimbursements for wellness and home office.

Other Perks:

  • Ability to make an impact: Join a rapidly growing and entrepreneurial-spirited team at a pivotal point to positively impact the food industry.
  • Opportunities to grow: Advance within Chomps quickly based on outstanding performance.
  • Unlimited PTO and 15+ paid holiday days + quarterly mental health days. Hybrid & flexible remote schedule. Chicago office open to those in the area.
  • Paid maternity and paternity leave.
  • Bi-annual total team in-person activities.
  • Company-wide Continual Education budget.
  • Unlimited snacks: Enough meat sticks that if you wanted to eat your body weight in them you could (no judgment here).

Our Commitment

Chomps is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. To achieve our mission of making nutritious food more accessible we greatly benefit from a range of perspectives, which comes from diversity of all types, at all levels of the organization. Achieving true diversity and inclusion is the right thing to do and the smart thing for our business.

We're aware of the research showing that historically underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a job if they don't believe that they meet all of the criteria. Do you hesitate to submit an application because you believe you need to check every box? Please apply anyway with a thoughtful cover letter! We would love to hear from you to discuss how you can help us build a great team at Chomps.

You must reside in the United States to be considered for this position. Chomps does not provide employment-based visa sponsorship at this time. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Important Notice:

It has come to our attention that fraudsters have been posing as Chomps employees or recruiters and contacting job-seeking candidates regarding potential job opportunities. These fraudulent messages sometimes include a request for payment and confidential personal information. Please note that the Chomps recruiting process does not include asking candidates for payments or other confidential financial information. If you are applying for a job, you can confirm the legitimacy of a job posting by viewing current open roles: . If you have questions please email us at

Deliver Outstanding Customer Support

  • Own and continuously improve the Customer Experience knowledge base by creating, updating, and organizing internal documentation and customer-facing support content.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Help refine support processes, templates, and customer communications to improve quality and consistency.
