raw.title: Senior Software Engineer (Fundraising) — Remote
raw.excerpt: GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011.
raw.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

Location: This role is fully remote but you must overlap with East Africa Time and US Eastern Time (8am-6pm) by at least 3 hours. As an example, 6PM East Africa Time is 11AM US Eastern time in the summer and 10AM in the winter. In practice, if you are in the Eastern US timezone, that means being regularly available for 8AM meetings and some 7AM ones. We know people have commitments like school drop-offs, so you’re encouraged to set a schedule that works for you -- as long as there’s sufficient overlap with the team. Please note that we can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

About this role:

Are you an experienced engineer at the stage of your career where, above all, you want to do good?

This role is about using engineering to support fundraising: delighting our donors; helping our fundraisers; getting donations recorded and safely started on their journey to our recipients; telling donors and the public about what happens to their gifts. A bit of website development. A lot of plumbing.

The good news about this position:

  • You will make a difference to people in extreme poverty
  • You will work independently, with few constraints
  • You will work directly with lovely people from across our fundraising teams

The trade-offs:

  1. There is only one other fundraising engineer and mostly you will be working on your own
  2. Our technology is a mixture of boring (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML and CSS) and legacy (Salesforce, Wordpress, wrangling CSV files sent by our partners)
  3. We're growing, but this is a role for someone who values depth and impact over a fast title ladder.

The maybe good maybe bad news about the role depending on who you are:

  • We are all in on AI where it allows us to get more $ to people in extreme poverty

If you want a role where you will be part of a bigger engineering team, working in Python or working on more complex tasks, then please take a look at our other engineering roles.

This role is right for you if:

  • You care about our mission
  • You agree with our values
  • You have the right to work in one of the countries we're able to hire from (you can check the current list here).
  • You're happy working remotely, and taking meetings across East Africa Time and US Eastern Time.
  • You are happy to travel to meet your colleagues in the US, Europe and Africa a few weeks a year
  • You are fluent in English
  • You have 4+ years of engineering experience
  • You're happy working autonomously: defining what needs doing, doing it, getting it tested and launched, fixing the bugs, and hustling to make progress every day.
  • You're comfortable being on-call on peak donation days (Giving Tuesday and the last weeks of the year), including owning an incident: working out what matters, communicating with fundraisers, and debugging on legacy and others' code, sometimes when no other engineers are available.
  • You are happy with our boring and legacy technologies (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML, CSS, Salesforce, Wordpress, SQL, wrangling csv files etc). You don’t have to be experienced in all of them, but you do have to be genuinely happy to use them (many engineers are not…).
  • You are happy and skilled at working directly with non-engineers on messy, poorly defined, rapidly changing, sometimes boring tasks

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

  • Base Salary: $181,130
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$27,170, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~$31,789 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $208,300+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

  • Base Salary: £124,370
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~£18,656, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~£21,827 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: £143,026+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

  • Base Salary: $112,350
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$16,853, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~$19,717 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $129,203+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,453

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

Why work at GiveDirectly?

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

  • A positive and supportive team with opportunities for advancement
  • A demonstrated commitment to helping all staff develop and grow
  • A competitive salary, including bonus
  • A robust health benefits plan (exact details will vary by country)
  • Unlimited PTO (that we encourage staff to take!)
  • Desk allowance and flexible work location

About this specific hiring process

  • Take-home coding assignment
  • Live Coding (60 mins)
  • Systems Design (60 mins)
  • Project Deep Dive + Behavioral (60 mins)

*It’s possible that there will be adjustments to this interview process. Any changes will be communicated to you during the process.

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

Referrals

Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them. We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

raw.description:
This opportunity is for Nielsen’s Gracenote division - the premier entertainment metadata company in the world, powering the search, discovery, and navigation systems for the globe's biggest tech, automotive, and media giants.

As entertainment becomes more fragmented and AI reshapes the way people discover and engage with content, trusted data and technology are powering the future and are the foundation for better experiences. In partnership with our clients and by fully embracing AI, we are reinventing the business, products and teams to capture a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity which will significantly impact the media and entertainment ecosystem as a whole.

As a leader within the Gracenote Customer Success Management (CSM) organization, you will serve as the primary strategic partner for a top-tier global account while leading a team of enterprise CSMs. This high-impact role demands senior-level relationship management dedicated to driving product adoption, maximizing net revenue retention (NRR), and fostering strategic growth. You will champion best-in-class practices, represent key stakeholders to internal leadership, and manage critical escalations. The ideal candidate possesses deep industry expertise and a strategic mindset to develop long-term account plans, map key decision-makers, and ensure the collective success of both the team and our clients with Gracenote.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Serve as a player-coach to a team of CSMs, actively mentoring, developing, and empowering them to cultivate top-tier talent and drive professional growth.

  • Collaborate with CSM leadership peers to synthesize market trends, establish industry-leading best practices, and champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance organizational performance.

Retention & Growth of Existing Accounts

  • Drive growth by proactively mitigating churn and identifying expansion opportunities via a structured adoption program for direct accounts and full pod set of accounts.

  • Execute Joint Business Plans and Quarterly Business reviews to align solutions with client goals and maximize strategic growth.

  • Cultivate senior-level customer relationships through systematic stakeholder mapping and quarterly executive engagement.

  • Proactively manage renewal cycles and monitor overall client health and risk.

Strategic & Operational Rigor

  • Partner with Sales to develop, maintain, and communicate a multi-year strategic client plan.

  • Lead monthly internal meetings to drive operational excellence and high-priority initiatives.

  • Facilitate senior-level internal and external account reviews.

  • Manage RFPs, RFIs, SOWs, and proposal responses for new opportunities.

  • Maintain a comprehensive, client-specific playbook.

  • Monitor and ensure adherence to contractual commitments, including SLAs.

  • Work with management to design and implement key performance indicators (KPIs) for the assigned client segment.

  • Drive engagement around upcoming renewals.

  • Create and deliver Quarterly Business Review (QBR) presentations, documenting highlights and action items.

Product Adoption & Quality Management

  • Drive 90%+ feature adoption and manage client readiness for new product releases.

  • Gather stakeholder feedback quarterly to influence the product roadmap.

  • Resolve complex quality escalations and support Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) for high-severity issues.

  • Proactively address quality trends with structured action plans and regular updates across the pod and circulate to leadership and core partners across content, product, and engineering.

  • Manage product lifecycles, including communications on retirements, replacements, and limited releases.

  • 7+ years of global account management experience with relevant media and technology experience, with 3+ years in leadership.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English (plus relevant local languages where required) and expert-level presentation capabilities.

  • Proven analytical skills, with the ability to design, interpret, and present data-driven solutions.

  • Strong project management, problem-solving, and organizational skills, including the ability to manage complex deadlines and stakeholder needs.

  • Proficiency in documentation, change management, and identifying upsell opportunities.

  • Flexibility to work regional hours and travel to client locations and trade shows as needed.

How you will lead through Our Nielsen Way

  • We dream big and own the details: Take end-to-end accountability for delivering excellence; focus on meaningful impact; get the details right; cut through complexity to drive results; and take informed risks to innovate and grow.

  • We embrace uncertainty to shape the future: Understand clients’ needs and share in their success; use data and insights to power decisions; provide clarity even without certainty; and build on Gracenote’s legacy while earning trust for the future.

  • We push forward with speed and agility: Move with urgency, pivot as needed, challenge constructively to find the best solutions, and create ways to deliver in days or weeks rather than months or years.

  • We achieve together and celebrate each other: Bring out the best in people, show up as a truly global company, seek diverse perspectives, recognize contributions, and celebrate successes and learnings.

  • We live Inclusion, Courage, and Growth: Begin with trust and respect, make bold and informed decisions, invite feedback, remain curious, and develop yourself and others.

Enabling your best to power a better media future.

Holistic Rewards: We are committed to an inclusive benefits package that supports our employees and their families. This includes comprehensive health and wellness plans, a 401(k) with a Nielsen company match, and a generous paid time off policy. Depending on the role, additional benefits may include a company-provided vehicle and/or discretionary incentive/bonus eligibility.

Compensation Transparency: The posted base salary range is a reasonable estimate that may be adjusted based on the final work location of the selected employee. Individual pay within the range is determined by factors such as experience, training, geography, certifications, and business needs. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other incentives.

Nielsen makes hiring decisions without regard to disability status, protected veteran status, or membership in any other protected class.

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a domain. About UdemyUdemy is an AI-powered skills acceleration platform transforming how companies and individuals across the world build the capabilities needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving workplace. By combining on-demand, multi-language content with real-time innovation, Udemy delivers personalized experiences that empower organizations to scale workforce development and help individuals build the technical, business, and soft skills most relevant to their careers. Today, thousands of companies, including Samsung SDS America, On24, Tata Consultancy Services, The World Bank, and Volkswagen, rely on Udemy Business for its enterprise solutions to build agile, future-ready teams. Udemy is headquartered in San Francisco, with hubs across the United States, Australia, India, Ireland, Mexico, and Türkiye. Udemy recently combined with Coursera to create one of the world’s most comprehensive skills development platforms.

Coursera + Udemy lets you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

About your Skills

  • Problem Solving: You are skilled in creative problem-solving techniques to address client needs, overcome obstacles, and drive sales outcomes, ensuring customer satisfaction and business success.
  • Coachability: You demonstrate a strong willingness to learn, adapt, and incorporate feedback to enhance strategies and achieve performance targets, fostering continuous personal and professional growth.
  • Curiosity: You exhibit a natural curiosity and hunger for knowledge, constantly seeking to understand market trends, customer preferences, and competitive analysis to inform strategy and drive business success.
  • Outbound Mindset: You possess a proactive outbound mindset, driven to identify new business opportunities, cultivate relationships with prospects, effectively communicate value and supported by your research and rigor throughout the process.

About this role

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Large Enterprise Account Executive to join our dynamic sales team in Mexico, LATAM territory. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying and closing new business opportunities with enterprise-level clients, which are companies with 5k employees and above. You will LAND AND EXPAND**

What you'll be doing:

  • Identify, prospect, and qualify new enterprise-level business and upsell opportunities within assigned territory
  • Coordinate and work with Udemy Business team (Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Product, Deal Desk, Legal, key executives) to ensure territory success; customer satisfaction, expansion and retention
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers to understand clients' business objectives and challenges to effectively position our solutions as a strategic fit
  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to meet and exceed sales targets
  • Lead negotiations and close complex sales deals, ensuring contracts are executed accurately and in a timely manner
  • Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, customer feedback and competitor activities; then relay and share any insights with your team!

​What you’ll have

While this work is based more on the skills a person has than what they have done, we think a typical profile could include the following:

  • We are looking for a highly motivated, over-achieving “hunter and closer” who flourishes in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Speaks proficient or native Spanish
  • A minimum of 7+ years of closing experience in B2B Enterprise sales (SaaS experience preferred) or equivalent
  • Enterprise-style go-to-market playbook that includes value-based selling and leveraging Value Engineers/Solution Engineers in pre-sales
  • Experience partnering with other Account Executives in an overlay specialist sales model
  • Success in opportunity creation and “full funnel” management of many opportunities
  • Proven history of exceeding targets in selling licenses/products/subscriptions to Enterprise organizations with demonstrated ownership of all aspects of territory management

Posting Date: September 24, 2026
Application Window:
We anticipate the application window will be open until October 8th, 2026. Based on business needs, this opportunity may remain posted beyond or closed before the anticipated application window.

At Udemy, we strive to be transparent around compensation. Actual compensation for this role is based on several factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition to a base salary, this role is also eligible for equity and uncapped OTE.

OTE Compensation Range
$1,240,000—$1,550,000 MXN

Why work here?

You’ll grow here.Learning is part of the job. You’ll get full access to Udemy courses, a monthly UDay to invest in yourself, and a budget to spend on whatever helps you improve. Many people are diving into AI lately, but what you focus on is up to you.

AI is real here.We use it in the way we learn and the way we work. You’ll have the space and tools to experiment, apply, and get better at using AI in practical ways.

You’ll own your work.We trust people to lead, make decisions, and follow through. You don’t need to wait for permission or layers of approval to have an impact.

You’ll build with others.We collaborate openly and shape ideas together. Everyone has a voice, and good thinking is welcomed from any direction.

You’ll see your impact.What you build helps people grow their skills, change their careers, or find a path forward. You’ve got the experience, why not use it to help others gain theirs?

Bring your curiosity. We’ll bring the platform and the support. Let’s LEARN together.

Our Benefits Start with U

Our benefits start with you and were built to provide you and your family with the protection and care you need, making it easy to access the right coverage when you need it most. Benefits vary by region, and we encourage applicants to review our Australia Benefits, India Benefits, Ireland Benefits,Mexico Benefits, Turkiye Benefits & US Benefits, pages to get an understanding of some of the benefits we offer. For details on region-specific benefits, please refer to the information provided during the hiring process.

Benefits outlined are provided as a general overview and may vary depending on the location, role, and employment classification. All benefits are subject to change at the discretion of the organization and in accordance with applicable laws and policies.
At Udemy, we value diversity and inclusion and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition, or disability. We understand that not everyone will match each of the qualifications. However, we also realize that everyone has unique experiences that can add value to our company. Even if you think your background might not perfectly align, we'd love to hear from you!
To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera.org/udemy.com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page. If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form.

Praktika is an AI-native education company on a mission to deliver efficient, engaging language learning to billions of people worldwide. We're bridging the gap between traditional learning apps and human tutors through a fully automated tutorship experience powered by generative AI avatars.

Since launching our mobile apps in 2023, we've grown to over 2 million monthly active users, become one of the world's top-4 learning apps, and recently closed a $30M Series A to accelerate our roadmap. We're a fully distributed team of ~50 people across 4 continents and 15+ countries, working asynchronously to ship fast and operate at a high bar.

We're hiring aUser Acquisition Managerto help us evolve our web direction at Praktika. This is a hands-on role for a performance marketer who enjoys owning campaigns end-to-end: from campaign setup and optimisation to performance analysis and new channel launches.

You'll partner closely with our Creative team, Growth and the web funnel team, and your work will directly shape how learners discover Praktika on the web.

What you'll do

  • Manage day-to-day performance and optimisation of web acquisition campaigns across different media sources, making data-driven decisions on scaling, pausing or restructuring.

  • Set up and run experiments across creatives, audiences, signals and campaign setups.

  • Analyse campaign and creative performance and turn insights into actionable next steps.

  • Support the launch and testing of new channels, campaign types and advertising formats.

  • Work closely with the Creative team on creative testing, performance analysis and iteration of new concepts.

  • Contribute to web funnel optimisation by bringing UA insights and identifying growth opportunities.

  • Use AI tools and automation to streamline reporting, creative analysis, campaign optimisation and other recurring UA workflows.

  • Collaborate with advertising partners and account managers to improve performance and support new initiatives.

  • Stay current on industry trends, platform updates, privacy changes and emerging AI capabilities in performance marketing.

What we're looking for

We're looking for hands-on performance marketers who thrive in a fast-moving environment, bring a growth mindset, and operate with a high degree of agency and autonomy.

Required

  • 1.5+ years of hands-on User Acquisition / Performance Marketing experience.

  • Experience with Google / Microsoft Ads and/or Meta / TikTok Ads.

  • Experience independently managing paid acquisition campaigns and making day-to-day optimisation decisions.

  • Strong understanding of campaign optimisation, testing, attribution and core performance metrics.

  • Analytical mindset: you understand what drives campaign performance and turn insights into actions.

  • Interest in performance creative: you analyse creative performance, spot patterns and suggest new tests.

  • Interest in the product side of acquisition: you connect campaign results with landing pages, funnels and offers.

  • Strong attention to detail and high execution speed.

  • Comfortable using AI and automation tools in day-to-day work.

  • Upper-intermediate or advanced English.

Bonus

  • Experience with Pinterest, Snapchat, AppLovin or other channels.

  • Experience with web acquisition, subscriptions or international markets.

How we work

  • Mission-driven: we're building the #1 language learning app and competing to win.

  • AI-native; AI isn't a feature; it's how we think, build, and scale.

  • Extreme ownership; every project has a clear owner who drives it to success.

  • Less meetings, more outputs; async first; meetings are a last resort.

  • Speed & excellence; move fast without compromising quality.

  • Truly all-in: impactful work, full commitment, real rewards.

  • Data-driven; decisions are based on evidence, not opinion.

  • User-obsessed; if it doesn't improve the learner experience, it doesn't matter.

  • 26 days of holiday plus bank holidays (34 days per year total).

  • Health and wellness benefits via SafetyWing.

  • Full AI toolkit access: Claude, Cursor, Codex, and other productivity tools.

  • $1,000 annual education and learning budget.

  • Fully remote: work from wherever you do your best work.

Why should you join Praktika:

We expect dedication and hard work, but we also believe in rewarding it. Our compensation reflects the effort and results you bring to the table.

  • Top-tier salary to match your top-tier skills

  • Equity that grows with your impact: equity growth via stock options

  • 26 days holidays plus bank holidays (34 days per year)

🌟 Exciting Remote Opportunity! We're Hiring an Executive Assistant! 🌟

We are seeking an exceptional Executive Assistant based in South Africa to serve as the trusted right-hand operational partner to the owner of a fast-growing construction and civil engineering firm based in Richmond, Virginia!

🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 🔗

🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH.

📋 Job Details at a Glance

  • Job Title: Executive Assistant

  • Job ID: CHAJAZ1EA

  • Industry: Construction & Civil Engineering

  • Location: South Africa

  • Employment Type: Full-Time

  • Work Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

🏢 About the Client

Our client is the owner of an established, fast-growing construction and civil engineering firm operating in a high-demand, field-based environment in Richmond, Virginia. Currently working 70–80 hours per week across field operations and business leadership, the owner is making a strategic investment in dedicated executive support. You will be among the first remote professionals integrated directly into the company's core operations to build stronger systems, improve operational visibility, and protect executive bandwidth.

💼 About the Role

This is not a traditional administrative support role. As the Executive Assistant, you will serve as the owner's trusted right-hand partner, taking direct ownership of key financial, operational, and administrative workflows. You will bring structure to a fast-moving environment, managing cash flow, field receipts, communications, and SOP development without requiring constant supervision.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

  • 💰 Cash Flow, Bookkeeping & Job Costing (Top Priority): Prepare and issue invoices promptly, monitor accounts receivable, follow up on overdue payments, code receipts/expenses in QuickBooks Online, maintain accurate job-costing records, and organize supporting financial documentation.

  • 🧾 Field Receipt Management: Establish and maintain an efficient process for collecting, tracking, and matching receipts from field contractors to appropriate project files to reduce missing information delays.

  • 📧 Inbox & Communication Management: Organize high-volume Outlook email traffic into project-based folders, archive key project communications, screen inbound messages, review call summaries, and prioritize critical issues to protect the owner's schedule.

  • ⚙️ Operational Support & SOP Development: Identify operational bottlenecks, create structured remote-to-field workflows, and document Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for receipt collection, expense reporting, and document filing.

  • 📅 Executive Support: Handle calendar coordination, scheduling, travel planning, administrative tasks, and ad-hoc operational requests with urgency and professionalism.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Core Requirements:

  • Experience: Proven track record as an Executive Assistant, Senior Administrative Assistant, or Operations Coordinator working directly with business owners.

  • Financial & Tech Mastery: Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online, bookkeeping, invoicing, accounts receivable, and expense/job-cost tracking.

  • Software Fluency: High proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word) and Google Workspace.

  • Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills; highly organized with obsessive attention to detail and accuracy.

🌟 Preferred / Highly Valued:

  • Experience supporting construction, civil engineering, trade, contracting, or field-service businesses.

  • Hands-on experience with construction-related job costing and managing high-volume project documentation.

Entrepreneurial Director of Strategic Accounts

About the Role

You will help design and implement Strategic Account Management strategy at Brightidea to grow revenue with a key group of named accounts. You will be responsible for driving customer success. The role requires solid relationship building skills coupled with an ability to think strategically. Your interactions with the customer will represent the Brightidea culture and create value for customers which will ultimately drive revenue.

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Work closely with senior executives to design and implement Strategic Account Management strategy
  • Own overall relationship with your portfolio of customers; identify and partner with key customer stakeholders to ensure alignment between their business and priorities and Brightidea.
  • Lead key partnership initiatives including quarterly business reviews, ongoing checkpoints, and escalations as needed
  • Build fundamental account plans, operational strategy and drive revenue growth
  • Identify opportunities for up-selling and expand Brightidea’s revenue
  • Work closely with internal Brightidea teams such as Legal, Sales Operations, Customer Success and the Implementation teams
  • Identify close conversion and cross sell opportunities to maximize the penetration rate for additional products and services into the existing enterprise client base
  • Leverage relationships with Innovation decision-makers in one division or location across different divisions to sell into another
  • Use CRM to: optimize your productivity, accurately forecast, and transparently communicate sales metrics and customer information
  • Be the expert in Brightidea offerings and stay on top of industry trends within the Innovation Management space

What You Need to Succeed

  • 10+ years in an enterprise commercial, strategic client success, account management role
  • 5+ years enterprise software
  • Experience interacting with and building relationships with C-Level stakeholders within Named Accounts
  • Strong track record and history of carrying and exceeding targets
  • Account planning and execution skills
  • Strong time management skills
  • Proven consultative sales solution skills, including the ability to articulate clear and concise value statements
  • Ability to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, collaborative, and team-oriented environment
  • Proven ability to systematically develop, drive and close business opportunities
  • Creativity and flexibility to drive sales strategies into existing accounts
  • Thoughtfulness – the ability to know what the customer needs before they know they need it
  • Track record of building and maintaining long term relationships with customers

Background

Helping large companies innovate isn’t easy, but it is vital. Vital to creating new jobs, vital to igniting growth, vital to ensuring a safe, healthy and prosperous future for billions around the globe.

But, innovation at large companies is a mess. Employees often have lots of ideas to improve the business, but, with no formal process, their ideas go unheard, and they eventually give up trying to make a difference. Corporate innovation teams are expected to support a growing list of activities but have historically lacked strong tools designed for the job. Executives, despite having millions to invest, live in fear of disruption, and still have no idea where their “next big idea” will come from, or if it will come at all.

Our Company & Culture

We are a tight-knit, entrepreneurial minded team of self-starters who show up every day with a singular mission: to transform the way the world innovates. Our primary focus this year is to continue to add exceptionally talented and motivated individuals to the Brightidea team. We are ambitious, bold, highly-collaborative, focused, and we aim to win. We take a humble approach to changing the way corporate R&D teams run innovation challenges.

Anyone joining our company will have the opportunity to shape the culture and be an integral part of setting it up for long term success. If you identify with being humble, T-shaped, and relentlessly resourceful then this could be the perfect team for you to shine in.

Compensation

$150,000 - $350,000 OTE depending on size of quota

title: Senior 3D Product Render Artist
description: The RoleWe'd like to conduct an experiment.  Visit dbrand.

raw.title: Senior 3D Product Render Artist
raw.excerpt: The RoleWe'd like to conduct an experiment.  Visit dbrand.
raw.description:
The Role
We'd like to conduct an experiment. Visit dbrand.com. Take a leisurely scroll through our product displays. Now, try to guess which images you saw were real-life photography and which were renders.
If you're struggling, it means we did a good job. If you aren't, you might be able to do an even better one.
We're looking for a Senior 3D Product Render Artist: someone who can take a raw CAD file from our Industrial Designers and turn it into an image asset so convincing that tech publications are fooled into believing we got early iPhone access. Someone who owns every render from raw STEP file to final frame. Most importantly, someone who doesn’t need an Art Director looking over their shoulder during the process.
That individual probably works in-house at a consumer hardware brand right now. Or at least, the agency that brand hired. Maybe they're in deep with the concept render community, dreaming up devices that don't exist yet, but look real enough to get confused for actual hardware leaks. Or perhaps they're topping the charts on ArtStation's Industrial & Product Design channel. To be perfectly honest, we don't particularly care what they're doing right now. We care about what they can do here, for us.
Do the above paragraphs describe you? Of course not. You don't work here... yet. But if you have the skills we need, you certainly could.
The Environment

Still here? Excellent. dbrand thrives where other eCommerce companies have failed because our customers enjoy an uncanny degree of commitment, engagement, and access from us. Maintaining an internal culture of excellence, the likes of which our highly-engaged audience demands, is critical to dbrand's current and future success.
As our Senior 3D Product Render Artist, your work will be scrutinized. Not just by us, but by our millions of customers, site visitors, and social media followers. Remember: our audience owns the exact devices you're rendering. They know what the chamfer looks like, how the anodization plays with the light, and whether the colour on their screen matches the device in their hand. They also have opinions. Strong ones, posted publicly, with a high degree of visibility. Get something wrong and you'll hear about it within seconds of publication.
Your role is to make sure they never get the chance. You'll live within our Photography team, feeding renders to our website, social channels, video projects, and packaging. You'll work with our Graphic Designers and Software Engineers to animate product pages, and with our Videography team to build 3D scenes and motion graphics. Full pipeline, start to finish: refine, shade, layout, light, render - and even animate, when the brief calls for it.
Agility is key. During peak seasons, you might be staring down the barrel of 1,000 renders spanning the launch calendars of Apple, Google and Samsung. Every one of them has to be both perfect and on time. Brute force won’t get you there. What will: scene systems, procedural shaders, render templates, and a pipeline where the first SKU takes hours and the second takes minutes. The question isn’t whether you can render 1,000 assets - it’s whether you can build the machine that does, then spend your time on the hero shots that matter.
Agility cuts the other way, too. Sometimes, speed is more important than perfection. Picture this: a new phone leaks. The creative team sparks an idea for a social media post… but we don’t have an asset to use. We get on a 5-minute call to talk about the idea. You disappear for a few hours into Blender. Next thing you know, we've turned stills for a product page into a million views on an Instagram Reel.
At times, you’ll spend the better part of a week building a hero animation that has to survive frame-by-frame scrutiny from an audience on Reddit who obsesses over the device. Other days, the brief might be “if we post this by EOD, it’ll probably go viral.” Both are the job. The trick is being able to switch gears depending on the requirements.
At dbrand, your renders won't die in a slide deck. They'll be the first thing millions of people see when a new iPhone drops, and the last thing our competitors see before they fail to copy your work. Let's see if you've got what it takes…

The Characteristics

  • Agile: You’re nimble. You’re adaptable. You thrive in an environment where priorities can change in an instant.
  • Analytical: Your decisions are driven by only one thing: data. You continue to master all the tools necessary to surface insights.
  • Collaborative: You enjoy purposeful meetings. You value the contributions and perspectives of your colleagues as much as you do your CEO.
  • Curious: You’re eager to learn new concepts and master new skills. There’s no useless tool in your arsenal.
  • Disciplined: You never allow the details to slip, understanding that every bit of minutiae forms the bigger picture.
  • Enthusiastic: You exhibit a contagious passion for solving problems OR finding solutions.
  • Innovative: You develop new approaches to complex problems.
  • Perfectionist: You persist until the smallest detail has been optimized. Giving less than 100% is not an option.
  • Persistent: You’ve never failed. You’ve only experienced speed bumps on your path to success.
  • Reliable: You live up to both verbal and written agreements. You can be trusted to work effectively, without oversight.

The Responsibilities and Qualifications

The Responsibilities
In order to make a positive impact as part of our team, your focus in this role will be to:
  • Own realistic product renders for the dbrand website end to end, from engineering CAD through to final export.
  • Build and maintain scene systems, so a new SKU on an existing product line comes out consistent with the rest of the catalogue in a fraction of the time.
  • Create animated 3D elements for dbrand drop pages.
  • Turn still-shot prep into same-day social cuts when the brief calls for it.
  • Create animated 3D scenes and motion graphics for dbrand videos.
  • Create ad-hoc 3D elements as needed.
  • Hold both quality and schedule through peak season, when the render count runs into four figures.
The Qualifications
  • 5-10 years’ professional experience.
  • Native fluency in Blender or Cinema 4D. Additional skills in Houdini, 3ds Max, or Unreal Engine are an asset, but not required.
  • Knowledge of converting industry standard CAD (STEP, STL, OBJ) files into workable 3D assets for production.
  • Advanced skills in shading / texturing / UV mapping / lighting / rendering.
  • Proficient knowledge of photographic and cinematic techniques (composition, advanced lighting, depth of field, editing) related to computer graphics production.
  • Working skills in 3D modelling / rigging / animation.
  • Ability to take Industrial CAD files of products through a full pipeline (refine, shade, layout, light, render, animate) to create technically proficient and creatively advanced cinematic compositions (i.e. reels for YouTube videos and TikTok, etc.).
  • Core competency in Adobe software suite (Photoshop, Illustrator).
  • Ability to self-direct and take ownership of a project within a given creative mandate.
  • An impeccable communication style - your grasp of the English language is flawless.
  • Detail-oriented, self-sufficient, resourceful, organized, and proactive.
  • The instinct to help teammates thrive and the openness to learn from past experiences.
  • The ability to solve complex problems (or know where to find the answer).
  • Commitment to long-term growth and learning opportunities.
  • Nice to haves:
    • Experience creating high-concept creative advertising animations.
    • Basic knowledge of CGI VFX techniques (3D tracking, match move, HDRI lighting, etc.).
    • Basic knowledge of titling / captioning / transitions.
    • Basic knowledge of video codecs / compression schemes / aspect ratios.

The Moment of Truth

The job starts between $150,000 and $175,000 per year based on experience, with health, dental, vision, GRSP, and profit-sharing benefits. The position is fully remote, but when required, our HQ is located a few minutes west of Pearson Airport.
Still think you have what it takes to thrive in our agile, high-growth, fast-paced environment?
To be perfectly honest, we doubt it.
You’re welcome to prove us wrong.
Vacancy Disclosure: This is a new role.

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Job Overview

Jensen Hughes is seeking a motivated, proactive, and relationship-driven Business Development Specialist – Healthcare & Emergency Management (HCEM) to support the continued growth of our Healthcare and Emergency Management service line. This role will be responsible for executing business development initiatives with a focus on new client acquisition, expansion of existing client relationships, lead and opportunity development, and consistent management and follow-through of business development activity.

The Business Development Specialist will work closely with the HCEM Business Development Manager, HCEM leadership, Operations, regional Business Development teams, Marketing, and other internal stakeholders to execute established growth priorities and identify new opportunities. This individual will support targeted client outreach, account development, lead generation, pursuit activities, renewals, and pipeline management while ensuring consistent follow-through from initial engagement through opportunity development and proposal.

Our goal is to hire a business development professional who is highly proactive, organized, and relationship-oriented and can help turn HCEM growth priorities into consistent business development activity and results. The individual will serve as a day-to-day resource connecting clients, Business Development, and Operations while helping position the full capabilities of Jensen Hughes to support both HCEM growth and broader company-wide opportunities.

This will be a full-time salaried position without commission.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute business development activities aligned with HCEM's annual growth objectives, target markets, priority accounts, and strategic initiatives.
  • Proactively identify and develop new leads and opportunities through targeted outreach, existing client relationships, industry involvement, internal referrals, and other business development initiatives.
  • Conduct consistent outreach to prospective and existing clients through calls, emails, meetings, industry events, campaigns, and other relationship-development activities.
  • Build and maintain relationships with clients and prospects while developing an understanding of their organizations, priorities, challenges, and potential needs.
  • Support the expansion of existing HCEM accounts by identifying opportunities for additional services, cross-selling, renewals, and broader Jensen Hughes capabilities.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up on leads and opportunities, ensuring next steps are identified, documented, and completed to help opportunities progress through the sales pipeline.
  • Support pursuits from lead through close, including client coordination, internal follow-up, proposal development, qualifications, scope and fee development, and coordination with technical and operational teams.
  • Partner with the HCEM Business Development Manager and Operations to engage the appropriate technical resources and subject matter experts throughout the business development and pursuit process.
  • Serve as a connector between HCEM Business Development, Operations including pre- and post-project teams and clients to support strong communication and continuity throughout the client relationship.
  • Maintain accurate and timely business development information within company systems, including client activity, leads, opportunities, pipeline, proposals, orders, renewals, and other key growth indicators.
  • Consistently utilize established business development processes and tools to provide visibility into activity, opportunity progression, client engagement, and results.
  • Support priority account and client development plans by coordinating outreach, meetings, follow-up activities, internal resources, and next steps.
  • Develop relationships at multiple levels within key accounts to strengthen Jensen Hughes' position, expand relationships, and identify future opportunities.
  • Support client retention and renewal efforts by proactively tracking upcoming renewals, coordinating internal resources, and maintaining consistent client engagement.
  • Clearly communicate the value of Jensen Hughes' services and connect client needs with the appropriate technical expertise, solutions, and capabilities across the organization.
  • Develop a strong understanding of HCEM services and the broader Jensen Hughes service portfolio to recognize and communicate potential cross-selling opportunities.
  • Maintain awareness of healthcare and emergency management industry trends, client challenges, competitive activity, regulatory changes, and emerging opportunities.
  • Participate in industry events, conferences, associations, and other client-facing activities to strengthen relationships, increase market awareness, and generate new business opportunities.
  • Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned business development activities and initiatives while maintaining a highly collaborative, team-oriented approach.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, and/or two (2) plus years’ experience as in business development and/or account management .
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook required.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 preferred.
  • Experience with government contract tracking systems or platforms used to monitor and research federal, state, or local government opportunities preferred.
  • Experience working for a professional services firm preferred.
  • General knowledge and confidence using computer databases and menu-driven reports.
  • Self-starter who works well independently and is self-motivated, with a bias for action.
  • Project coordination and organizational skills, attention to detail, and initiative to follow through.
  • Consistently perform at a high level in fast-paced and high-pressure environments.
  • Work with minimal supervision and in a team environment.
  • Exceptional Customer Service and strong listening skills.
  • Able to look at things multidimensionally and able to come to a unique and innovative plan or solution if a problem is identified.

While this position is fully remote, candidates based in New England, particularly Connecticut, are preferred. Candidates outside of the region are welcome to apply, and a willingness to travel to our Connecticut or New York office approximately quarterly is preferred.

Please note that the salary range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting and not a guarantee of compensation. Contact Center Agent

United States, United States (Remote)

Job Title: Contact Center Agent

Location: United States

Reports to: Program Manager

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Supervisory: No supervisory/management authority

Prepared Date: 9/15/2026

Position Type: Temporary / on-call, full-time during activation. Surge-driven; duration tied to disaster activity and the call order period of performance.

Work Schedule: Shift assignments include nights, weekends, and federal holidays. Shift times and weekly hours may change with 48 hours’ notice.

Work Location Requirement: Agent must be physically located within the United States or a U.S. territory (including Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U.S. Virgin Islands) at all times while taking calls.

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.

The Contact Center Agent supports FEMA’s disaster-assistance mission by serving as a direct point of contact for individuals and businesses affected by disasters. Agents provide registration support, answer questions, deliver accurate information, and connect callers with appropriate resources while safeguarding sensitive information.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting Salary Range for Contact Center Agent: Pay commensurate with experience.

This position is covered by the Service Contract Act. The hourly rate is set at or above the applicable Department of Labor Wage Determination for the county of performance under occupational category 01000, Administrative Support and Clerical Occupations.

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights include:

  • Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security
  • Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage
  • Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage

•Paid holidays

•Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Professional development, training, and certification support
  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

Contact Center Agent Responsibilities Include:

  • Serve as a direct point of contact for individuals and households registering for federal disaster assistance, asking questions about a prior registration, or seeking relief program referrals.
  • Conduct all calls with patience, tact, courtesy, and empathy to determine caller needs and provide instructions or referrals.
  • Conduct a scripted interview and enter caller-provided information accurately into FEMA’s Windows-compatible database (NEMIS-IA) while the survivor is on the phone.
  • Complete all data entry while the survivor is on the line. A maximum of 10 seconds of after-call work is permitted, and only in the event a call drops.
  • Provide phone numbers and agency referrals for applicable secondary support organizations and other disaster assistance providers.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned based on FEMA’s level of support to the event, which may include Registration Intake, Helpline, Transitional Sheltering Assistance, outbound calls, and document review.
  • Attend all scheduled pre-shift briefing sessions of up to 30 minutes at the beginning of each shift to receive event-specific information on work priorities, procedures, policies, and performance.
  • Meet established average handle time standards: Registration Intake 18 to 23 minutes; Helpline 10 to 12 minutes. Escalated and successive (Delta) calls may take longer.
  • Maintain schedule adherence and support interval service level requirements, including availability to take calls throughout the assigned shift.
  • Participate in quality control monitoring and evaluation, including a minimum of three evaluated calls or cases per week, and apply real-time coaching feedback.
  • Performs other duties as may be assigned.

Contact Center Agent Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen, at least 18 years old, and able to obtain and maintain FEMA/DHS favorable suitability adjudication before beginning training or call-handling duties.
  • Must have resided within the United States for at least three of the last five years, as required for federal suitability adjudication.
  • Prior customer service, contact center, administrative, clerical, or other public-facing support experience preferred, particularly in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Windows, Word, Excel, PDF documents, telephone systems, and multiple computer applications, including two-screen workstations.
  • Must be able to successfully complete identity verification through Login.gov in order to access FEMA tools and guidance requiring secure logins.
  • Must be able to pass E-Verify employment eligibility verification and provide a Social Security card issued by the Social Security Administration.
  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.
  • Strong English reading, writing, and verbal communication skills; bilingual agents must be fluent in English and Spanish.
  • Ability to follow detailed scripts, program guidance, job aids, reference materials, and established procedures while maintaining accuracy.
  • Ability to navigate multiple Windows-based applications and FEMA systems while conducting live telephone interviews and accessing reference materials simultaneously.
  • Ability to accurately collect, enter, and review caller information; assess needs; provide appropriate instructions and referrals; and address questions or concerns within assigned authority.
  • Ability to safeguard PII, Sensitive PII, Sensitive But Unclassified, and For Official Use Only information; maintain a secure workspace; and promptly report suspected security or privacy incidents.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about the office for extended periods.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Spanish/English bilingual proficiency, including the ability to fluently speak, read, and write in both languages.
  • Experience supporting disaster assistance, public assistance, health and human services, insurance, benefits, or comparable public-facing assistance programs.
  • Experience using FEMA systems, NEMIS-IA, Registration Intake, Helpline, Transitional Sheltering Assistance, or comparable case-management systems.
  • Experience working remotely in a secure, private home-office environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet quality, productivity, schedule-adherence, and average-handle-time expectations in a contact center environment.

Company Information:

Behind every government mission stands skilled, mission-driven talent: people whose expertise and dedication turn complex challenges into successful outcomes. Cherokee Federal, the federal contracting division of Cherokee Nation Businesses, is that team. We modernize aging systems, deliver care where it’s needed most, and keep missions supplied, staffed, and moving across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. For more than 60 federal clients, we take on the work others won’t, and deliver where it counts. If that’s the kind of work you’re looking for, you’ve found your team. Learn more at cherokee-federal.com.

#CherokeeFederal

Cherokee Federal is a military friendly employer. Veterans and active military transitioning to civilian status are encouraged to apply.

Legal Disclaimer: Cherokee Federal is an equal opportunity employer. Please visit cherokee-federal.com/careers for information regarding our Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer Statement, and Accommodation request.

Many of our job openings require access to government buildings or military installations.

Compliance Notices

Cherokee Federal is a federal contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA). As required by VEVRAA, we take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans. Protected veterans are encouraged to self-identify during the application process.

Cherokee Federal takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified individuals with disabilities in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. Qualified individuals with disabilities are encouraged to self-identify during the application process.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified individuals with disabilities or those with sincerely held religious beliefs. To request an accommodation in the application or interview process, please contact Human Resources at .

raw.title: Senior Project Manager, Enterprise Eligibility Data Management
raw.excerpt: Primary Purpose The Senior Project Manager is responsible for providing overall direction, coordination, execution and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with Bright Horizons methodology and goals.
raw.description:
Primary Purpose


The Senior Project Manager is responsible for providing overall direction, coordination, execution and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with Bright Horizons methodology and goals. This individual leads the delivery team for client projects, oversees project management of assigned department initiatives, and drives best practices with the project delivery within department and via collaboration with Senior Project Managers and leaders across service delivery teams/departments to ensure consistency within Bright Horizons practices. Responsibilities include project planning, consulting, managing project resources, project management duties including time management, resource management, client relationship management, and team process leadership. The Senior Project Manager leads a team of project managers, is a trusted advisor for the client projects, and is an internal partner with other department leaders to drive the overall success of our project delivery.

This is a remote position available in the United States.

Bright Horizons is a leading education and care company that helps employees thrive at work and at home by partnering with employers to offer high-quality child care, elder care, and educational support. Our workplace reflects this commitment—with collaborative environments, meaningful benefits, and a culture that supports both career growth and personal well-being. Whether you’re caring for children or powering the systems and partnerships that make it all possible, at Bright Horizons, you’re the difference.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

  • Drives all project-related activities for assigned clients/projects with attention to efficiency, timing and superior service to the client and/or intended audience.
  • Takes ownership of the project communications and processes to ensure successful outcomes and aligned expectations. Produces consistent high level communications to internal and external stakeholders on project status, risks, and changes recommended. Facilitates the escalation process in a timely and constructive manner to pull in the appropriate team that will own the issue resolution.
  • Executes on the project delivery processes and methodology to support total quality of project deliverables.
  • Estimates time frames, quality and quantity of resources required to successfully implement the project; develops project plan incorporating all project variables and facilitates completion of client change orders, as required.
  • Establishes project mitigation and change request process. Navigates project changes effectively, removes barriers and coordinates with a variety of cross-functional project team members.
  • Partners with the internal and external service delivery team leaders to manage, track, and optimize the resource management needs across the department’s projects.
  • Drives knowledge sharing within and across projects. Facilitates the proper archiving and accessibility of the project deliverables with the consulting delivery team.
  • Assesses and minimizes business exposure and risk on project. Ensures project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately.
  • Oversees project management of greater departmental initiatives as assigned
  • Collaborates with department leaders to best practices and continual improvements, and is a key driver on maintenance and enhancements to department collaboration and project management tools
  • Works to achieve operational targets with major impact on the departmental results. Contributes to the development of goals for the department and planning efforts
  • Manages and develops a team of project managers to support client and department projects
  • Overnight travel as required for client and organizational meetings.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma
  • 4+ years of experience as a project manager
  • 1 year of experience leading project teams

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree, ideally in business or operations
  • Requires related business experience that includes managing a team, strong analytical skills, organizational skills, follow through skills, leadership skills.
  • Requires project management, consulting, technology, process improvement, negotiation, and strong communication skills.
  • Requires ability to work effectively and collaboratively in a fast paced environment across other functions including Growth, Product, Employee Services, Finance, IT, HR, and Marketing.
  • Hands-on experience leading and executing large complex projects for ERP and/or HR systems implementation is desirable.
  • Project management professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI) or similar project management certification is desirable.
  • Requires the ability to remain organized at all times and to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources including team members, other internal departments and external parties (such as 3rd party partners).
  • Experience with Monday.com, Azure ADO, JIRA, Salesforce, Microsoft suite, ITIL or HDI standards a plus.

At this time, Bright Horizons will not sponsor an applicant for employment authorization/visa for this position.

Be part of a community where people grow, futures are shaped, and lives are changed. We offer the rewards, opportunities, and support you deserve because making a difference goes both ways. We’re changing the world of work and family, and it starts with you. At Bright Horizons, you’re the difference.

Compensation:

The annual salary for this position is between $93,000-$105.000 The pay range listed here is what Bright Horizons in good faith anticipates offering for this job opening. Actual compensation offers within this range will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education and training, certifications, geography, and other relevant business or organizational factors.


This position is also eligible for a bonus.

Also, depending on hire date and subject to applicable eligibility requirements and accrual schedules, new employees in this role receive up to: 9 paid holidays annually; 40 hours of sick time per year based on full-time schedule, and 80 hours of vacation time per year based on full-time schedule (vacation time may be used for sick leave purposes under any applicable state or local sick or safe time law).

Benefits:

Bright Horizons offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

· Medical, dental, and vision insurance

· Paid vacation, sick, holiday, and parental bonding leave

· 401(k) retirement plan

· Long-term and short-term disability insurance

· Life insurance

· Money-saving discounts and financial planning tools

· Tuition assistance and education coaching

· Caregiving support and resources for the children and adults in your family

· Learn more at

Deadline to apply: This position is anticipated to remain open until 10/1/26

Life at Bright Horizons:

At Bright Horizons, you’re more than your job title — you’re the difference. Whether you’re nurturing a child’s first steps or supporting the systems behind the scenes, your work creates real impact. We’re a community that celebrates individuality, invests in your growth, and supports your whole self. Because when you thrive, so do the children, families, and clients we serve. Join us and help build a brighter future — for yourself and for others.

Bright Horizons provides equal opportunity in all aspects of employment and does not discriminate against any individual on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, national origin, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or local law. Bright Horizons complies with the laws and regulations described in the following federal government resources: Know Your Rights, Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA).

If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation in completing these application materials or any aspect of the application and hiring process, please contact the recruitment helpdesk at 855-877-6866 or . Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

raw.excerpt: TITLE: National Accounts Sales Manager LOCATION: Remote (West Region) REPORTS TO: National Segment Sales Manager POSITION SUMMARY: To implement current sales strategies and drive specification position for Nichiha products with the Architect, Brand, Specifier, General Contractor and Installer community.
raw.description:
TITLE: National Accounts Sales Manager

LOCATION: Remote (West Region)

REPORTS TO: National Segment Sales Manager

POSITION SUMMARY: To implement current sales strategies and drive specification position for Nichiha products with the Architect, Brand, Specifier, General Contractor and Installer community. The National Brands Sales Representative manages product promotion to influence the design and specification process and position Nichiha’s products for use on National Brand’s prototype store designs while effectively utilizing their time and resources to increase sales output.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Implement agreed upon sales strategies (i.e. sales programs)
  • Evaluate effectiveness of current sales strategies and programs
  • Interface with, and build relationships with National Brand Accounts, Architects, General Contractors, Installers and other influencers in the construction community
  • Influence the specification process with Designers/Specification Writers/Creators
  • Build a prominent specification position for Nichiha products
  • Develop partnerships within the general contractor and installer community to increase awareness of Nichiha’s products
  • Identify and target top Brand accounts, as well as Designers, Architects, and General contractors that can influence material changes while positioning Nichiha as a cladding of choice
  • Manage existing accounts while identifying and targeting potential new National Brand Accounts
  • Identify projects where Nichiha has been specified or submitted. Develop an understanding of Nichiha’s product competition and various price points
  • Create and maintain a project pipeline in Salesforce.com
  • Track/Maintain specified/submitted project pipeline through to order received stage
  • Document all activities in Salesforce.com
  • Present AIA/CES courses to Architects
  • Assist in development of new AIA CES offerings
  • Provide feedback on current AIA/CES offerings
  • Present Product Knowledge trainings to general contractors and installers
  • Coordinate market intelligence on product, program, shipping and market segments.
  • Collaborate with other Nichiha personnel as required to provide technical assistance, training, project-start-up, contractor assistance, problem resolution, etc.
  • Manage the sales process through brands and/or contractors as required
  • Collaborate with Field Technical personnel to develop a trained and consistent installer base
  • Participate in design organizations and promotional/trade show activities
  • Participate in national promotional/trade show activities as required
  • Assist in Product Development
  • Gather information on competitive activity and prospective strategic directives

Professional Qualifications / Skills

  • Bachelor’s Degree in related discipline strongly desired
  • 2+ years of sales experience in B2B environment (building materials sales preferred)
  • Ability to travel up to 50%
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with clients and maintain a robust national account client database
  • Proficient in face-to-face sales and calling on national accounts
  • Must be a self-starter and self-motivator, and work independently
  • Ability to create product and technical presentations
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • General understanding of the construction process
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, blue prints, etc. Experience with Bluebeam is a plus
  • Experience using Construct Connect and other construction data software desired
  • Experience using a CRM tool (Salesforce.com preferred)
  • Understanding of social media trends
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office products, specifically MS Word, MS PowerPoint and MS Excel

raw.title: Business Development Representative Remote
raw.excerpt: The BDR is responsible for contacting potential clients via phone and email, following established business processes to generate partnerships with Aprende Recruiting.
raw.description:
The BDR is responsible for contacting potential clients via phone and email, following established business processes to generate partnerships with Aprende Recruiting. This role will be 100% in English and focused on the U.S. market.
Aprende Recruiting is an affiliate company of Aprende Institute, focused on connecting businesses with qualified, job-ready talent. Through strategic agreements with medium- and large-sized companies in various industries such as hospitality, tourism, and healthcare, among others, we offer job opportunities to thousands of Spanish-speaking professionals in the United States.

﻿

We are looking for a BDR to contact interested companies and schedule meetings with our Head of Partnerships. This person will also provide insights and information gathered from phone calls and other communications to improve the service offering.
The role involves meeting targets for meetings and quality, managing information about Aprende Recruiting effectively, and using the companys tools and platforms.
﻿
﻿Responsibilities:
Contact and Prospect Management (85%)

  • Contact companies from a provided prospect list through calls and emails.
  • Present Aprende Recruiting and generate interest in our services.
  • Schedule meetings with decision-makers (HR, recruiters, talent acquisition leaders) for the Head of Partnerships.
  • Conduct structured follow-ups to confirm meetings and maintain the prospects interest.

Identifying New Opportunities (15%)

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

Our engineering teams build the technology behind this experience - from AI-powered products and clinical workflows to scalable backend systems, data infrastructure, cloud platforms, and internal automation tools. We solve complex technical challenges where reliability, security, and product impact directly affect patient care.

While we may not have an open role that matches your profile today, we're always interested in connecting with talented engineers who are passionate about building products that make a real difference.

Areas we frequently hire for

  • AI Backend Engineering
  • Frontend Engineering
  • DevOps & Platform Engineering
  • Data Engineering
  • AI / ML Engineering
  • Full-stack QA Engineering

Our Engineering Stack

Our teams work with modern technologies including AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, Aurora, EKS, Bedrock), Angular 21, Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, LangChain, LangGraph, Google Gemini, and AWS Bedrock, alongside AI-powered development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.

We follow a modern engineering approach with 2-week sprints, continuous delivery (including multiple deployments per day), and a high level of AI adoption across software development, testing, code reviews, simulations, and engineering workflows.

Requirements

What we offer

  • Growth & compensation - competitive compensation and clear opportunities for professional growth.
  • Remote-first culture - fully remote, long-term B2B collaboration designed for professionals across Europe and nearby regions.

  • Career development - ongoing career growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.

  • Team culture - virtual and in-person corporate events, team gatherings, and thoughtful gifts for important life events.
  • Strong collaboration - work closely with experienced Product, Data, AI, and Engineering teams in a fast-moving environment.
  • Meaningful challenges - solve complex engineering problems at the intersection of healthcare, AI, automation, and data.

﻿How the Talent Pool works

By joining our Engineering Talent Pool:
