Job Title

Provider Outreach and Education Representative I

Job Summary

The Provider Outreach and Education (POE) Representative is responsible for delivering Federal and State-aligned, data-driven education to providers and suppliers to reduce error rates, repeat provider inquiries, and claim submission errors. The role develops compliant education materials, analyzing operational data to identify risk and error trends, and coordinating education activities across internal and external stakeholders to improve provider understanding and reduce operational burden.

Essential Functions

Key Duties/Responsibilities/Accountabilities

  • Educates and facilitates provider education through webinars, teleconferences, in-person meetings, and workgroups as a subject matter expert aligned with Federal and State priorities to reduce repeat provider inquiries, claims errors, and error rate findings.
  • Possesses strong communication and organizational skills to successfully deliver education to executive level stakeholders such as internal individuals, Customer officials, and Associations related to new programs or changes within current program policies.
  • Builds relationships with subject matter experts within various divisions of Federal and State to support new and existing programs.
  • Follows established quality standards for education documentation and assists with corrections or updates as needed to ensure continued Federal and State compliance.
  • Analyzes data and tracks trends in claims errors, error rate findings, medical review referrals, and provider inquiries to develop targeted education.
  • Assists in monitoring post education trends to evaluate the impact of education on provider inquiries, claims errors, and error rate findings.
  • Maintains current and extensive knowledge of Federal and State rules, regulations, processing guidelines, and Internet-Only Manuals (IOM).
  • Creates and maintains Federal and State -compliant, Section 508 accessible education materials and web content.
  • Coordinates with internal departments to support operational improvement and reduce repeat work through education.
  • Serves as a professional subject matter expert in Federal and State -mandated meetings and provider forums.
  • Participates in aligning education activities to Federal and State identified risk areas and assists with tracking education focus areas based on inquiry trends, error rate data, and medical review referrals.
  • Documents education activities accurately and timely in Federal and State -required systems.
  • Supports Federal and State -mandated POE activities including Advisory Groups, ACTs, and reporting requirements.
  • Identifies process improvement opportunities and communicates recommendations to management.
  • Ensures confidentiality, security, ISO, and Federal and State compliance requirements are met.

Non-Essential Duties and Functions

  • Participates in pilot initiatives, special projects, and workgroups.
  • Provides backup support during periods of increased workload.
  • Performs other related duties consistent with position scope.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Health Information Management, Public Health, Business, Communications, Education, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered including Federal, and State or Medicare experience as determined by Human Resources
  • 2 years Medicare experience
  • Strong analytical and communication skills
  • Experience applying Medicare policy, regulations or processing guidelines

Preferred Qualifications

Above requirements and the following:

  • 4 years' Medicare experience
  • Provider education or public speaking experience

Environment and Cognitive/Physical Demands

  • Office Environment
  • Ability to read, hear, speak, keyboard, reason, communicate effectively and problem solve
  • Requires prolonged sitting and telephone usage
  • Requires the use of office equipment such as computer terminals, telephones, copiers and printers
  • Infrequent stooping
  • Infrequent lifting up to 15 pounds
  • Travel required

Segregation of Duties

Every employee is responsible to perform their duties and responsibilities in accordance with Noridian values, policies and procedures, including but not limited to: Segregation of Duties Principles, HIPAA, Security and Privacy, CMS requirements, the Noridian Compliance Program and any other applicable laws, rules and regulations.

Statement of Other Duties

This document describes the essential functions, requirements, and responsibilities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Employees may be requested to perform job related tasks other than those specifically listed in this description and may be required to perform any task requested by the supervisor or management.

Total Rewards Package:

Health, Dental and Vision Insurance, Voluntary Insurance Plans, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, 401k and Company Match, Company-paid Life Insurance, Education Assistance Program, Paid Sick Leave, Paid Holidays, Increasing PTO Accrual Plan, Medical/Parental/Disability Leave, Workers Compensation, Retiree Benefits, Severance Package, Employee Assistance Program, Financial and Health Wellness Benefits, Casual Dress, Open Office Setting, and Online Learning System.

CMS Access Compliance and Regulation Contingency Statement

Some positions require compliance with (i) federal and agency-specific regulations and federal contract requirements, and (ii) eligibility to obtain and maintain federal identity credentials and authorized access to government facilities, information systems, networks, sensitive information, or applications.

To obtain federal identity credentials and authorized access, employees in this position may be required, as a condition of employment, to successfully complete federal identity verification, federal background investigation and adjudication, credentialing, and access authorization processes in accordance with applicable federal requirements. Federal identity credentials and authorized access will not be issued to candidates who have not resided in the United States at least three (3) out of the last five (5) years.

Failure to obtain and maintain eligibility for required federal credentials and access authorization may result in removal from the position or termination of employment.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law.

The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c)

Job Description

This role provides an integrated and strategic approach to marketing, understanding the company's business objectives and translating them into effective and compelling communications.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning and development of progressive and effective marketing strategies, product launches and/or campaigns that support Prime's brand and drive sales of Prime and its products, programs and services; support implementation efforts as needed
  • Collaborate with cross-functional business partners and stakeholders on the senior leadership team to deeply understand Prime's business objectives, product offerings, client utilization/adoption and history, and intended market positioning

raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to own the operational readiness and ongoing health of our fleet of Data Centers, both COLO and BTS sites. In this role you will be the single point of accountability for ensuring each site runs as expected — SLAs met, maintenance executed on schedule, and audits passed — across a growing portfolio of landlord-operated and purpose-built facilities. You will operate as the primary interface between Nebius and our data center landlords and operators, and you will partner closely with the Nebius IT team to translate site-level operations into reliable infrastructure for our customers.

This is an individual contributor position for someone who is equally comfortable in a contractual SLA review, a maintenance window planning call, and a physical site audit. You will define the mechanisms that keep our sites accountable and surface risk before it becomes an incident.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the operational health of Nebius COLO and BTS sites, ensuring each facility runs to expectation across power, cooling, space, connectivity, security, and environmental controls.
  • Track, monitor, and enforce SLA compliance across landlords and colocation providers; identify breaches, drive remediation, and hold providers accountable to contractual commitments.
  • Manage and coordinate site maintenance schedules — preventive and corrective — including planning and approving maintenance windows, reviewing Methods of Procedure (MOPs), and minimizing risk to live workloads.
  • Plan and drive site audits covering compliance, capacity, power/cooling performance, physical security, and safety; track findings to closure.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day interface with data center landlords and operators, managing the operational relationship, escalations, and coordination of on-site activity.
  • Partner closely with the Nebius IT team on deployments, capacity planning, incident response, and change management at each site.
  • Build reporting mechanisms and dashboards that give leadership clear visibility into site health, SLA performance, maintenance status, and open risk across the portfolio.
  • Lead incident coordination and post-incident follow-up, including root cause analysis and corrective action tracking with landlords and internal teams.
  • Track and manage contractual operational obligations, deliverables, and timelines across multiple sites and providers simultaneously.

About the team

The Data Center team is responsible for the physical infrastructure that underpins Nebius' AI cloud. We manage the full lifecycle of our COLO and BTS footprint — from bringing new capacity online to keeping live sites running reliably at scale. We work at the intersection of facilities operations, vendor management, and IT infrastructure, and we move fast because our customers' AI workloads depend on the reliability we deliver.

Basic qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in technical program management, data center operations, or critical facilities/infrastructure management.
  • Experience managing data center infrastructure and operations (power, cooling, space, connectivity) in colocation, build-to-suit, or owned environments.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors, landlords, or service providers against SLAs and contractual obligations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple programs, sites, or workstreams simultaneously and drive them to measurable outcomes.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with colocation (COLO) and build-to-suit (BTS) data center models, including operating across multiple landlords and operators.
  • Working knowledge of data center SLAs, MOPs/SOPs, maintenance regimes, and audit and compliance frameworks (e.g., Uptime Institute Tier standards, SOC 2, ISO 27001).
  • Experience supporting AI/HPC, GPU cluster, or other high-density compute infrastructure.
  • Strong familiarity with incident management and root cause analysis in a critical facilities context.
  • Experience building reporting mechanisms, dashboards, or operational scorecards for infrastructure health and risk.
  • PMP, Uptime ATD, or equivalent program/operations certification.
  • Proficiency with program and ticketing tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow) and comfort working with operational data.
  • Willingness to travel to sites as needed.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

Coretek is seeking a Senior Azure Infrastructure Consultant to lead customer Azure infrastructure engagements from discovery and design through implementation, validation, documentation, and transition to managed services. This role is ideal for a senior delivery consultant who can operate as a trusted customer advisor, technical escalation point, and future architect-level contributor. Coretek Services is an industry-leading consulting and managed solutions provider based in Southeastern Michigan, built on a foundation of passionate technology professionals who embody our values of Accountability, Integrity, and Relationships. Coretek specializes in AI & data, cloud, virtualization, networking, security, modern data center, and mobility technologies, and is distinguished as a Microsoft Azure Expert MSP.

SUCCESS IN THE ROLE

  • Deliver customer projects on budget, on schedule, and aligned to defined business and technical outcomes while creating a high-quality customer experience.
  • Serve as a reliable technical escalation point who resolves complex issues and uses those situations to strengthen team capability.
  • Partner effectively with Project Management to set expectations, communicate risks, and maintain clear stakeholder alignment throughout engagements.
  • Contribute to Coretek’s relationship-based culture by consistently demonstrating Accountability, Integrity, and Relationships in work with customers and internal teams.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead discovery and requirements definition to understand the customer’s business drivers, technical constraints, and desired outcomes.
  • Design and implement Azure infrastructure solutions, including detailed solution designs, implementation plans, validation steps, and operational documentation.
  • Implement new Azure environments using Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework principles, including migration of on-premises and cloud workloads through Azure Migrate where appropriate.
  • Validate implemented solutions for functionality, security, resiliency, and operational readiness before customer handoff.
  • Facilitate onboarding of customer environments to Managed Services through clear knowledge transfer, support transition planning, and complete documentation.
  • Develop implementation plans and technical guidance that enable other team members to execute build activities consistently and accurately.
  • Perform troubleshooting, remediation, and root cause analysis for complex Azure infrastructure issues.

Additional responsibilities may include:

  • Support development and review of Statements of Work, technical scopes, solution assumptions, and estimates for complex Azure engagements.
  • Review solution designs and bills of materials with manufacturers, partners, or internal stakeholders to confirm alignment with project requirements.
  • Improve Coretek-defined standards, templates, and repeatable delivery assets based on field experience and lessons learned.

Requirements

TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE & CAPABILITIES

  • Core Azure Infrastructure: Virtual Machines, Virtual Machine Scale Sets, storage solutions, Azure Migrate, Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, monitoring, logging, and operational readiness.
  • Networking: ExpressRoute, virtual networks, routing, load balancing, Azure Front Door, Application Gateway, Private Link, private endpoints, and ingress services.
  • Platform Services: Azure SQL Database, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure App Service, Cosmos DB, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and related PaaS capabilities.
  • Security, Identity, and Governance: Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access control, encryption, data protection, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and governance frameworks.
  • Cost Management: Azure Cost Management, cost optimization, rightsizing, tagging strategy, and consumption management practices.

Delivering via Automation and IaC

Well-qualified candidates will have experience deploying Azure infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code and automation. Core experience should include the ability to use provided modules, scripts, and pipelines, and to edit or refactor existing code. Relevant tools and platforms may include ARM or Bicep templates, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub, Packer, Azure DevOps, and PowerShell.

Additional Skills of Value

Coretek delivers a broad portfolio of solutions, and candidates with cross-domain experience that complement Azure infrastructure delivery will be especially valuable. Differentiating experience may include DevOps, AI and data platforms, Microsoft 365 Enterprise, merger and acquisition solutions, Citrix and Microsoft virtualized end-user computing, modern security solutions such as SOC and SIEM platforms, enterprise and cloud networking, network security, load balancing, modern data center technologies, and non-Azure public cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.

raw.excerpt: A Nuuvem, uma líder na distribuição digital de jogos na América Latina, é conhecida por sua paixão profunda por jogos e uma forte presença no mercado.
raw.description:
A Nuuvem, uma líder na distribuição digital de jogos na América Latina, é conhecida por sua paixão profunda por jogos e uma forte presença no mercado. Estamos em busca de talentos para fazer parte da nossa guilda de pro players, conquistando muito XP ao longo do caminho.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Designer de Comunicação Pl. para fazer parte do nosso time criativo e ajudar a transformar ideias, campanhas e briefings em experiências visuais que conversem com a nossa comunidade.

No dia a dia, essa pessoa vai trabalhar na criação e no desdobramento de campanhas para diferentes canais, passando pelo nosso e-commerce, redes sociais, e-mail marketing, materiais institucionais, apresentações e peças impressas. Por isso, buscamos alguém que consiga entender diferentes necessidades de comunicação e traduzi-las em soluções visuais funcionais, consistentes e alinhadas à identidade da Nuuvem.

Para essa vaga, seu portfólio será uma parte importante do processo. Queremos conhecer seus projetos, entender seu repertório visual e ver como você transforma conceitos e briefings em design.

🚩 Esta oportunidade é válida para trabalho remoto. Fornecemos todos os equipamentos necessários para você mandar bem no seu trabalho, seja ele onde você escolher ser! Você só precisa garantir uma internet de qualidade 😉

Requirements

  • Experiência com criação e design, especialmente no desenvolvimento de materiais para marketing, campanhas digitais, comunicação institucional ou endomarketing.

  • Domínio de Figma e Adobe Creative Cloud, principalmente Illustrator, Photoshop e InDesign.

  • Boa base de tipografia, hierarquia visual, teoria das cores e diagramação, sabendo aplicar esses fundamentos na construção das peças.

  • Experiência criando materiais para diferentes canais e formatos, como redes sociais, banners, apresentações, materiais institucionais, logotipos, identidades visuais e campanhas online e offline.

  • Conhecimento de preparação e fechamento de arquivos tanto para materiais digitais quanto impressos.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com criação de landing pages e Webflow.

  • Conhecimento de Figma Motion ou outras ferramentas e recursos de motion.

  • Experiência ou familiaridade com Direção de Arte e construção de conceitos visuais para campanhas de varejo.

📍Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar conceitos visuais e peças para campanhas de marketing, comunicação institucional e endomarketing, tanto para canais digitais quanto para materiais impressos.

  • Desdobrar identidades e conceitos de campanha para diferentes formatos, como redes sociais, banners da loja, e-mail marketing, brindes e materiais gráficos, mantendo consistência entre os pontos de contato.

  • Garantir que os materiais produzidos estejam alinhados à identidade visual e às diretrizes de marca da Nuuvem.

  • Desenvolver templates editáveis em ferramentas como Canva, Figma e PowerPoint para apoiar outras áreas da empresa na criação de materiais recorrentes sem perder a consistência visual.

  • Criar e diagramar apresentações comerciais, institucionais e executivas para diferentes públicos e necessidades.

  • Desenvolver peças para redes sociais, incluindo posts estáticos, carrosséis, capas e outros formatos utilizados nos nossos canais.

  • Criar landing pages, trabalhando desde a estruturação visual até a publicação, com atenção à responsividade e à fidelidade do layout.

  • Preparar e finalizar arquivos para diferentes meios, considerando especificações de impressão, formatos, padrões de cor e otimização de imagens para web.

Importante: não deixe de aplicar caso não tenha todos os conhecimentos ou experiências acima! Sua capacidade de aprendizado e evolução é mais importante do que um "checklist" de conhecimentos e experiências prévias.

📍Modalidade e Faixa Salarial

A modalidade para essa posição é CLT, com faixa salarial aproximada de R$4.200,00 a R$4.700,00.

📍Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odonto:Cuidar da sua saúde é coisa séria. Aqui, você conta com um plano de alto nível, com desconto simbólico de R$ 1 em folha de pagamento.

  • Cartão iFood Benefícios: O Vale-refeição tá diferente… Mas para melhor, com certeza! Aqui na Nuuvem oferecemos um saldo mensal de R$1.000,00 no Cartão iFood Benefícios que é bandeira Elo, aceito em milhões de estabelecimentos no Brasil na função crédito à vista tanto na categoria alimentação quanto refeição! 😎

  • Ajuda de Custo Mensal: Todo apoio é bem-vindo! Mensalmente oferecemos R$ 250,00 para nosso time estruturar seu ambiente de trabalho, home office e auxiliar nas contas de casa. 💵💰

  • Crescimento Pessoal: Não queremos que você pare de aprender nunca! Por isso, todo colaborador tem o saldo de $70 dólares por semestre para investir em seu crescimento profissional, seja em forma de curso, livro, workshop, eventos, etc.

  • 4 Days Off 4 you: aqui na Nuuvem todo mundo ganha 4 dias de folga por ano para tirar quando você quiser…🏖️

  • Carrinho de Jogo do Mês: Se eu te contar que todo mês você pode escolher quantos itens quiser da nossa loja, até atingir o valor total de R$360,00, você acredita? É isso mesmo, jogos totalmente grátis, do seu jeito e sem burocracia. Escolheu, jogou! 🎮

  • Cupom de 20%: Aí que a gente vê quem é amigo! Além do item do mês você ainda tem direito a 10 cupons de 20% na nossa loja anualmente para usar com você mesmo ou para dar de presente para amigos e familiares. A biblioteca de jogos agradece!

  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass): Ficar sentado no computador o dia todo não dá, né? Oferecemos acesso ao App Wellhub que tem convênio com diversas academias, estúdios e também inclui terapia, nutrição e treinos online.🧘🏻‍♂️🏃🏻‍♂️

  • AVUS: Porque saúde é prioridade para a Nuuvem! Com essa plataforma de benefícios, nosso time tem acesso à assistência virtual de alta qualidade e uma rede de profissionais em todo o Brasil, garantindo cuidados médicos personalizados a qualquer hora e lugar. 👨🏻‍⚕️🥼

  • Starbem: Porque saúde mental é importante para nós! Aqui você tem acesso ao app Starbem com consultas médicas, psicológicas e nutricionais, além de descontos em farmácias sem custos adicionais! 🫂🍉🍒

  • Stay: Seu futuro tranquilo! Com nossa parceria, você investe nos seus sonhos de forma simples e prática, com flexibilidade para ajustar suas contribuições. 🚀💰

👀 Procuram-se Sócios!

Programa de Stock Options: Por último, mas nada menos importante, aqui na Nuuvem você tem a chance de virar nosso sócio! Afinal, quem melhor entendedor da Nuuvem do que nosso próprio time? Sem pegadinhas, qualquer funcionário com pelo menos 1 ano de empresa já pode ser escolhido! A regra é clara: crescemos e ganhamos juntos!

📍 Outros atrativos bem legais

  • Aniversariantes do Mês: Não é só mais um ano de vida que nossos aniversariantes ganham! Nosso evento online de aniversariantes conta com um saldo para todos os nuuveiros fazerem seus pedidos de delivery, brindes e atividades especiais, além de muita jogatina, óbvio!

  • Flexibilidade de horário: Cada um no seu quadrado! Sabemos que cada um tem suas rotinas e preferências em termos de horário e tentamos respeitar isso ao máximo. Damos flexibilidade para cada time escolher o horário que melhor se encaixe na rotina de seus integrantes, sejam os que acordam pro café da manhã ou pro almoço.

  • Encontros de Time: Não conseguimos ficar muito tempo longe uns dos outros hehe Por isso, anualmente, nosso time inteiro vem para a Cidade Maravilhosa, vulgo Rio de Janeiro, para um momento de interação ao vivo com toda a equipe Nuuvem.

  • Ambiente descontraído, extremamente colaborativo e com alta transparência: Queremos manter sempre nosso ambiente leve, onde todos têm acesso a todos e à todas as informações necessárias. Está em nosso sangue ser co-op. Estamos prontos para ajudar em qualquer ocasião!

  • Ações de endomarketing: mesmo distantes, gostamos de comemorar datas especiais como páscoa, festa junina, dia do gamer e outras, sempre garantindo um mimo para os nuuveiros!

  • Equipe Gamer: Aqui somos todos (ou quase todos) gamers! Entendemos e vivemos as dores de quem tem paixão pelos jogos e trabalhamos incessantemente para fazer o melhor para nossa comunidade. Se você não joga, não tem problema! Nossa equipe abraça gamers de longa data e futuros gamers igualmente ;)

Se identificou? PRESS START!

Highlights

Designer de Comunicação Pleno para criar e desdobrar campanhas e conceitos visuais em diferentes canais, garantindo consistência da marca e experiências visuais alinhadas à Nuuvem.

raw.description:
Join Our Team at Zócalo Health!

About Us

Zócalo Health is a tech-enabled, community-oriented primary care organization serving people who have historically been underserved by the one-size-fits-all healthcare system. We partner with health plans, providers, and community organizations to deliver culturally competent primary care, behavioral health, and social care.

Our model is built for populations with high medical and social complexity, where fragmented care drives poor outcomes and unnecessary cost. We combine local, community-based teams with virtual care and modern technology to deliver coordinated, whole-person care where members live and receive support.

Founded in 2021, Zócalo Health is backed by leading healthcare and mission-aligned investors and is scaling rapidly across states and populations. We are building a durable care platform designed to perform in constrained healthcare environments and to lead the shift toward accountable, value-based care.

Why Join Us

At Zócalo Health, we value mission-driven work, collaboration, and innovation. Our team is made up of passionate professionals from diverse backgrounds, all working together to improve health outcomes and equity in care. Whether your expertise is clinical, operational, technical, or administrative, there’s a place for you to contribute and grow.

What We’re Looking For

We’re always on the lookout for talented individuals who:

  • Are excited by innovative healthcare solutions
  • Thrive in a collaborative and fast-moving environment
  • Are committed to equity, diversity, and community impact
  • Want to make a real difference in the lives of patients and communities

How to Connect

Even if there isn’t a current role that fits your background, we encourage you to join our talent network. Share your resume or profile with us, and we’ll reach out when opportunities align with your skills and interests.

What you can expect from Zócalo Health

  • Competitive salary
  • Equity compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision
  • 401k
  • Generous PTO policy
  • $1,000 home office stipend
  • We provide the equipment needed for this role.
  • Opportunity for rapid career progression with plenty of room for personal growth.

You must be authorized to work in the United States. Remote Work can be done from anywhere in the U.S.

At Zócalo Health Inc., we see diversity and inclusion as a source of strength in transforming healthcare. We believe building trust and innovation are best achieved through diverse perspectives. To us, acceptance and respect are rooted in an understanding that people do not experience things in the same way, including our healthcare system. Individuals seeking employment at Zócalo Health are considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.description:
Strategic Leadership

  • Define and execute the technology roadmap with a focus on AI-driven personalization and content intelligence.
  • Champion rapid prototyping and experimentation culture across engineering and product teams
  • Partner with Product, Editorial, Sales, and Marketing teams to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Lead AI/ML initiatives for content curation, recommendation engines, and predictive physician engagement.
  • Establish an experimentation framework with an A/B testing infrastructure and data-driven decision-making.
  • Drive innovation sprints and hackathons to accelerate the development of new features.

Platform & Architecture

  • Build robust community platforms enabling peer-to-peer engagement among healthcare professionals.
  • Develop a comprehensive MarTech stack integrating CDP, marketing automation, and omnichannel orchestration.
  • Architect first-party data infrastructure to capture, unify, and activate physician behavioral signals
  • Design scalable APIs and integration layers for pharmaceutical partner platforms and data exchanges.
  • Implement real-time personalization engines leveraging machine learning and behavioral targeting.
  • Create a modular, composable architecture supporting rapid feature deployment and experimentation.
  • Ensure platform reliability, security, and compliance with healthcare industry standards (HIPAA, etc.)

Team Development & Management

  • Build and scale a high-performing engineering organization embracing experimentation and innovation.
  • Foster a culture of rapid prototyping, fail-fast mentality, and continuous learning.
  • Establish innovation time (20% projects) and regular hackathons for creative exploration.
  • Implement agile development with emphasis on quick iterations and the MVP approaches.
  • Create cross-functional pods combining engineering, data science, and growth teams.
  • Partner with HR on talent acquisition, focusing on AI/ML and growth engineering expertise.

Data & Analytics

  • Build a comprehensive first-party data strategy to create a competitive advantage in physician engagement.
  • Develop unified physician profiles aggregating behavioral, preference, and interaction data across touchpoints.
  • Implement a customer data platform (CDP) for real-time audience segmentation and activation.
  • Create data clean rooms for secure collaboration with a pharmaceutical partners.
  • Design privacy-first architecture supporting targeted advertising without third-party cookies.
  • Build predictive models for content affinity, engagement propensity, and lifetime value.

AI & Innovation

  • Lead AI transformation with a focus on generative AI for content creation and summarization.
  • Implement LLMs for automated medical literature analysis and insight extraction.
  • Develop an experimentation platform that enables the rapid testing of new features and algorithms.
  • Create an innovation lab for exploring emerging technologies (voice interfaces, AR/VR, etc.)
  • Build ML pipelines for automated content tagging, classification, and knowledge graphs.
  • Foster a fail-fast mentality with a structured approach to proof-of-concepts and MVPs.

Community & Engagement

  • Design and implement features for the physician community, enabling peer collaboration and knowledge sharing.
  • Build social layers, including discussion forums, case studies, and peer review systems, to foster a collaborative environment.
  • Develop gamification strategies to increase engagement and platform stickiness.
  • Create user-generated content platforms with moderation and quality control systems.
  • Implement social proof mechanisms (ratings, reviews, endorsements) for content and CME programs.
  • Build referral and advocacy programs leveraging network effects.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Evaluate and integrate best-in-class MarTech vendors across the marketing technology stack.
  • Build strategic partnerships with AI/ML platform providers and data enrichment services.
  • Manage relationships with advertising technology partners for programmatic capabilities.
  • Collaborate with M3 global technology teams on shared AI initiatives and data strategies.
  • Present the technology strategy and experimentation results to the board and executive stakeholders.
  • Optimize technology spend with a focus on ROI from rapid prototyping and MVP validation.

Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, with at least 3 years managing engineering teams.
  • Proven track record in digital publishing, content management, or healthcare technology sectors.
  • Experience scaling platforms serving millions of users with high availability requirements.
  • Demonstrated success in AI/ML implementation and rapid prototyping initiatives.
  • Background in building experimentation frameworks and data-driven product development.
  • Track record in community platform development and user-generated content systems.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of AI/ML platforms, LLMs, and generative AI applications.
  • Experience with MarTech ecosystems (CDPs, DMPs, marketing automation, attribution).
  • Proficiency in building community platforms and user-generated content systems.
  • Strong background in experimentation platforms and feature flagging systems.
  • Knowledge of first-party data strategies, identity resolution, and privacy-compliant targeting.
  • Experience with real-time personalization, recommendation engines, and predictive analytics.
  • Familiarity with modern cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and event-driven architectures.

Leadership Skills

  • Strategic vision balanced with hands-on experimentation and a rapid iteration mindset.
  • Strong advocate for data-driven decision making and hypothesis-driven development.
  • Ability to build and champion a test-and-learn culture across the organization.
  • Excellent communication skills for engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience driving growth through technical innovation and rapid market testing.
  • Track record of building high-velocity engineering teams focused on business impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building professional communities or social platforms in healthcare/medical sectors.
  • Background in programmatic advertising, ad tech, and yield optimization.
  • Knowledge of Customer Data Platforms (Segment, mParticle, Adobe Experience Platform).
  • Experience with rapid prototyping methodologies (Design Sprints, Lean Startup).
  • Track record implementing generative AI in production environments.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7).
  • Experience with growth engineering and conversion rate optimization.
  • Background in building developer ecosystems and API marketplaces.

**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **

Location: Remote
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote / Telecommute
Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor
Industry: Community / Membership / Professional Networks
Salary Range:~$2,000–$2,500 USD per month
Schedule: Monday–Friday, typically 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET or CT
English Proficiency: Excellent written and spoken English required

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing professional community and membership organization serving thousands of accomplished entrepreneurs and founders who have successfully built and exited companies.

The organization creates meaningful connections and high-quality experiences through local chapters, curated groups, forums, events, workshops, and real-time community interaction.

The team operates with a high level of ownership, moves quickly, works remotely across time zones, and integrates AI deeply into day-to-day operations.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and relationship-oriented Community & Events Associate to help shape the day-to-day experience of a large and highly engaged founder community.

This role sits at the intersection of community management, content, communications, events, and program coordination.

You will own the content calendar, help determine what communications members receive and when, coordinate events and workshops from beginning to end, stay closely connected to conversations happening across the community, and help identify the topics, people, and opportunities that matter most.

This is a writing-heavy and execution-oriented role for someone who combines excellent communication skills with attention to detail, sound judgment, curiosity, and a genuine interest in people.

Why This Opportunity?

You'll have the opportunity to work closely with a community of thousands of experienced entrepreneurs and business leaders while having a meaningful impact on their member experience.

You'll also join a small, fast-moving remote team where:

  • You can take meaningful ownership early.
  • Your ideas and observations can directly influence programs and communications.
  • AI is actively used to make work faster and more effective.
  • You can see the measurable impact of the campaigns, events, and initiatives you manage.
  • There is significant room to grow based on your strengths and interests.

What You'll Do

Content & Communications

  • Own and maintain the community content and communications calendar, determining what goes out, when, and why.
  • Write, edit, and refine communications sent to members while maintaining a clear, natural, and consistent brand voice.
  • Build, test, and send email campaigns.
  • Select and manage appropriate audience segments for different communications.
  • Review campaigns carefully before launch, including links, formatting, dates, names, and other details.
  • Track campaign performance and identify what content and messages resonate most strongly with members.
  • Share insights and recommendations based on engagement and performance data.

Events & Programs

  • Coordinate virtual and occasional in-person events from planning through execution.
  • Create and manage registration pages, reminders, logistics, and event-day support.
  • Promote events to the most relevant members to drive attendance.
  • Coordinate speakers and workshops, including scheduling, confirmations, logistics, and run-of-show preparation.
  • Manage program communications including applications, deadlines, participant updates, and waitlists.
  • Follow up with attendees and participants after events.
  • Track which events, speakers, and topics perform best and use those insights to improve future programming.

Community Engagement

  • Stay closely connected to daily conversations happening within the community.
  • Develop a strong understanding of what members are discussing, asking about, celebrating, and struggling with.
  • Identify recurring themes, community wins, concerns, and opportunities for meaningful member connections.
  • Welcome new voices and help encourage thoughtful participation.
  • Provide first-line community moderation when needed.
  • Escalate situations requiring additional review or decisions to the appropriate internal team member.
  • Proactively identify members who may benefit from meeting or connecting with one another.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

You'll focus on understanding the community, its members, communication style, tools, and existing programs.

You'll begin supporting campaigns and events with guidance from the team.

By 60 Days

You'll independently manage much of the weekly communications calendar and take greater ownership of events and program execution.

By 90 Days

You'll have a strong pulse on the community and proactively surface what members need, what topics are gaining traction, and where the organization should focus next.

How We Work

AI-Assisted by Default

AI is an important part of the team's workflow.

You'll use AI tools to help with first drafts, summaries, reporting, research, organization, and repetitive tasks so that more of your time can be spent on judgment, relationships, creativity, and execution.

You should already be comfortable experimenting with AI tools and interested in becoming even better at using them.

Attention to Detail Matters

You'll be communicating with thousands of experienced founders and business leaders.

Small details matter.

You'll be expected to catch incorrect links, formatting issues, outdated dates, inconsistent names, typos, and other mistakes before anything is published or sent.

Async and Remote

The team works remotely across multiple time zones and communicates heavily in writing.

You'll be expected to:

  • Share updates proactively.
  • Flag blockers early.
  • Manage your time effectively.
  • Take ownership without waiting for constant direction.

Measure and Improve

Your work doesn't stop when a campaign is sent or an event ends.

You'll review what happened, understand what worked, identify what didn't, and help the team improve the next iteration.

Tools You May Use

The organization currently works with tools such as:

  • Customer.io or similar email marketing platforms
  • Event management platforms such as Luma
  • Notion
  • Google Workspace
  • Slack
  • WhatsApp
  • ChatGPT and other AI tools

You do not need previous experience with every tool listed above.

What matters most is your ability to learn new tools quickly and figure out how to use them effectively.

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent written English, with the ability to communicate naturally, clearly, and professionally.
  • Strong writing and editing skills.
  • Ability to adapt to an established brand voice rather than imposing your own writing style.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines, events, communications, and priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Proactive working style: you identify what needs to happen and take action.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and genuine interest in building relationships.
  • Comfortable communicating with entrepreneurs, founders, executives, and senior professionals.
  • Strong judgment, discretion, and professionalism.
  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow.
  • Ability to learn new software and systems quickly.
  • Willingness to communicate openly when blocked or when something requires additional attention.

Preferred Qualifications

These are helpful but not required:

  • Experience with Customer.io, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Braze, or a similar email marketing platform.
  • Previous community management or moderation experience.
  • Experience managing communities through WhatsApp, Slack, or similar platforms.
  • Event coordination experience, either virtual or in person.
  • Experience supporting a founder, investor, executive, professional, or membership-based community.
  • Previous experience working remotely and in an asynchronous environment.
  • Experience tracking engagement metrics and using data to improve communications or programming.

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity for someone who wants more than a narrowly defined coordination role.

You'll have exposure to a highly accomplished entrepreneurial community while developing experience across:

  • Community building
  • Content and communications
  • Events and programming
  • Email marketing
  • Member engagement
  • AI-enabled workflows
  • Performance measurement
  • Relationship building

Because the team is small, strong performers will have opportunities to take on increasing responsibility and grow into the areas where they demonstrate the most strength.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

raw.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity


As an Account Manager, you'll have the opportunity to shape the strategy and success of one of FICO's premier clients. Leveraging your consultative sales expertise and strategic mindset, you'll partner with a leading global financial institution to solve complex business challenges, drive growth, and deliver meaningful business outcomes through FICO's innovative solutions.


What You’ll Contribute

  • Strategic Leadership: Build and nurture relationships with C-suite and senior client stakeholders to uncover and address their most critical business challenges, demonstrating the value of FICO’s solutions at every turn.
  • Solution Innovation: Collaborate with internal teams across sales, product, delivery, and marketing to design tailored, enterprise-grade solutions that align with client needs and long-term strategies.
  • Complex Deal Structuring: Lead high-stakes negotiations for multi-million-dollar contracts, ensuring mutually beneficial outcomes that protect and expand FICO’s footprint within the account.
  • Client Advocacy: Serve as the voice of the client within FICO, influencing product roadmaps and solution strategies to address evolving market demands.
  • Business Growth: Develop and execute comprehensive business plans that drive account expansion and long-term profitability, while achieving quarterly and annual sales targets with significant upside potential.
  • Market Leadership: Represent FICO as a trusted advisor, staying ahead of industry trends and positioning the company as the go-to partner for advanced analytics and decisioning solutions.

What We’re Seeking

  • Someone who thrives on creating opportunities where none exist, enjoys opening executive relationships, builds pipeline from scratch, and consistently wins new enterprise customers. This role requires a high-agency individual who is resilient, commercially curious, and motivated by growth rather than account maintenance.
  • Demonstrated hunter mentality with a proven ability to identify, develop, and close new business opportunities.
  • Proven Senior-Level Experience: Demonstrated success in building and managing strategic relationships with senior executives, particularly within large institutions.
  • Enterprise Solution Sales Expertise: A track record of structuring and closing complex, multi-million-dollar deals, including SaaS-based solutions that expand existing offerings or integrate into larger solution bundles.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep familiarity with banking, credit risk, fraud prevention, account management, or consumer lending. Experience in applying technologies for massive intelligent decisions, machine learning, AI, decision management, and optimization is highly desirable.
  • Strategic Vision and Execution: Ability to craft and execute joint business plans that align with client objectives and FICO’s strategic priorities.
  • Growth Mindset: A Passion to learn and educate customers and FICO colleagues through presentations, and conversations. Strong soft skills, and a genuine interest in people and a desire to help them be wildly successful.
  • Resiliency: Able to maintain focus and effectiveness under pressure, adaptable to change, and recover quickly from setbacks.
  • Collaborative Leadership: A team-oriented mindset that values collaboration and leverages the collective strengths of colleagues to deliver exceptional results.
  • Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel up to 50% to maintain a close partnership with the client and foster meaningful, face-to-face interactions.
  • Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent commercial experience. ​

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

raw.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

Where you'll leave your mark?

    • Own Sprinto's AI browser extensions and AI features end to end — one of several streams within our AI pod, alongside accuracy baselining and automations — as its business owner, not just its product manager.
    • Define the problem statement from first principles — figure out what's worth building, why, and for whom, before a line of code is written.
    • Build the product and take it to first customers — work hands-on with an initial set of customers, one on one, to get it to a successful POC stage.
    • Drive distribution and adoption — partner with CX, Sales, and Marketing to take what worked in POCs to wider launch and measurable adoption across the customer base.
    • Own accuracy and quality for AI-driven features — set the bar, know the pitfalls of building on non-deterministic systems, and keep improving output reliability post-launch.
    • Operate with senior-level autonomy — set direction for this stream, make calls without waiting for a mandate, and be accountable for outcomes, not deliverables.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

    • 3–5 years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.
    • A business-owner mindset — you think in terms of customer outcomes, adoption, and impact, not tickets shipped.
    • A strong first-principles, structured thinker — able to break down an ambiguous problem space and build a clear path from idea to launch.
    • Hands-on with customers — comfortable running discovery, POCs, and feedback loops directly with early users to make them successful.
    • A strong cross-functional collaborator — you've taken products from build to go-to-market by working closely with CX, Sales, and Marketing.
    • AI product experience is a strong plus, not a requirement — if you've built AI-powered features, you know how to improve accuracy and avoid the common pitfalls; if you haven't, you should be able to reason your way there.
    • Comfortable with a fast, high-ownership environment — this role exists because we need someone who can pick up a stream and run with it.

How we care for our Sprinters?

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

Location: Remote – Open to Latin America (must have at least partial overlap with UK business hours)

Our client is seeking a skilled Fullstack JavaScript Engineer with strong, hands-on GraphQL experience to join their growing team. You will play a key role in designing and developing GraphQL APIs while building scalable frontend applications with React, TypeScript, and Node.js. Your work will directly impact the scalability, performance, and delivery of premium digital fitness products used by global brands and communities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain GraphQL APIs and backend services using Node.js and TypeScript, with a strong focus on API architecture, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Develop and integrate GraphQL schemas, queries, mutations, resolvers, and data models to support product requirements and frontend applications.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with GraphQL in production environments; this is the most important requirement for the role.
  • Solid understanding of GraphQL architecture, including schemas, queries, mutations, resolvers, and API design.
  • Strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript for backend/API development.
  • Strong experience with React and TypeScript for frontend development.
  • Experience designing, building, integrating, and consuming GraphQL APIs in full-stack applications.
  • Solid understanding of SQL databases, particularly PostgreSQL, and how they integrate with GraphQL-based applications.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed product and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GraphQL performance optimization, schema design, and API scalability.

  • Knowledge of Prisma ORM.
  • Experience with Tailwind CSS.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest.

  • Family-friendly leave policies.

Company Values

  • Always improving.
  • Grit to deliver.

raw.description:
About Franke

We, the Franke company with its three divisions, are a world's leading supplier of products and services for domestic kitchens, the professional foodservice systems and the convenience store sector as well as for professional coffee making. With around 60 companies, we are at home on five continents. Over 8,000 employees constantly take on new perspectives to identify opportunities and turn them into inspiring, innovative solutions for tomorrow’s demands.

The Franke Home Solutions division is the world’s leading provider of smart systems for domestic kitchens. Drawing on a long history of reliability and expertise, we help our partners enhance their businesses and provide outstanding kitchen and cooking experiences to our consumers by offering complete solutions for food preparation and cooking.

About the job

The Business Development Project Manager role is an 18-month assignment within Franke’s Graduate and Early Career Program, designed for an early-career professional interested in sales, business development, and commercial leadership. The role supports business development initiatives for Home Solutions North America (decorative showroom channel), including sales growth, market analysis, customer engagement, and strategic project execution. The successful candidate will be based in either the Chicagoland area or the Southeast region and will collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product Development, Finance, Customer Service, and Operations, while gaining exposure to senior leadership. This assignment provides the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, build practical commercial experience, and strengthen overall business acumen. Upon successful completion of the program, the individual may take on more responsibility, either in their current team, or in a different function/division/location based on the individual's performance and available opportunities.

Your tasks

  • Analyze sales data and market trends to identify growth opportunities and inform strategic decision-making for key accounts.
  • Develop and execute strategic business plans aligned with sales, product, and brand objectives.
  • Collaborate with Leadership and distributors to refine marketing strategies, including brand positioning, trade shows, and industry engagement.
  • Partner with Product Development and Marketing teams to support new product and service initiatives that respond to market needs.
  • Conduct trainings and presentations for customers and internal stakeholders based on business insights and project outcomes.
  • Monitor and report on sales performance, profitability, and growth metrics to track success and support decision-making.
  • Standardize measurement processes to evaluate impact on sales, profitability, and market share.
  • Support ad hoc projects and initiatives that drive business development and organizational objectives.

Education, Qualifications & Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.
  • Degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or another related field preferred.
  • Strong academic performance and demonstrated achievement through coursework, projects, internships, leadership activities, or extracurricular involvement.
  • Interest in building a career in sales, business development, commercial strategy, or general business leadership.
  • Ability and willingness to travel significantly within the United States.
  • Preferred location: Chicagoland area or East/Middle Tennessee region, or willingness to relocate to one of these areas.
  • Designed for candidates with a maximum of 2 years of relevant professional experience.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret information, identify trends, ask thoughtful questions, and translate data into practical recommendations.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to share ideas clearly and engage professionally with internal teams, customers, and business partners.
  • Commercial mindset, with an interest in customers, markets, products, sales growth, and overall business performance.
  • Initiative, curiosity, and accountability, with a willingness to learn, take ownership, follow through on commitments, and adapt to changing priorities

What we offer you

  • A set of challenging projects to lead with continuous exposure to senior leaders
  • Access to the FRANKE ACADEMY with a broad range of trainings to improve technical as well a soft skills and general knowledge of the company and products
  • Individual coaching from our coaching partner
  • Individual mentoring from a senior leader
  • Shadowing a senior leader
  • Support from a growing international GEC community

For more information see:

Important information for all executive search companies, headhunters and HR consultants

The Franke Group does not accept unsolicited support from headhunters and personnel consultants for our career opportunities. Any CV/resume vitae submitted to Franke or its employees by external recruitment agencies without a valid written recruitment agreement related to the position in question shall be deemed the sole property of our company. In the event that a candidate presented by an agency is hired in our company and there is no prior agreement, no fee will be paid.

In this role, you will play a key part in designing, developing, and enhancing agentic solutions in a cloud-native environment using industry-leading AI tools/platforms, Java, AWS, Kafka event streaming, Elasticsearch, containerization, and API-driven architectures.

This is an opportunity to join an agile, collaborative team where engineers have ownership, make meaningful technical contributions, and deliver solutions that directly impact WEX’s customers and business growth.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Design, develop, and deliver delightful product experiences that are powered by Agentic capabilities, scalable, reliable software solutions using modern technologies such as Java, Kafka, Elasticsearch, and cloud-native platforms.
  • Contribute to architecture and design decisions that support highly available, secure, and scalable systems.
  • Build and maintain clean, efficient, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Develop and optimize RESTful APIs and backend services.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and collaborative problem-solving sessions.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical challenges.
  • Work across technology stacks and quickly adapt to new tools and frameworks.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and industry best practices to continuously improve engineering practices.
  • Ensure operational excellence and best customer experience for all the products and systems owned by the team.


Experience You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 7+ years of software engineering experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-scale applications.
  • Strong experience building cloud-based applications and infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Proficiency with event streaming platforms such as Kafka.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch, including indexing strategies, query optimization, and data analysis.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, scalability, availability, and reliability.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex technical challenges.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Experience and knowledge in building Agentic/AI solutions for real world problems.
  • Experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures.
  • Experience working with card payments or financial services platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of API security principles and PCI DSS compliance requirements.
  • Experience working within existing codebases and improving legacy systems.
  • Strong backend development expertise with Java or C#, including frameworks such as Spring Boot.
  • Experience designing, building, and optimizing RESTful APIs, OData services, and SQL-based solutions.
  • Proven experience developing internet-scale services with a focus on scalability, security, availability, and reliability.
The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $140,600.00 - $173,100.00

raw.description:
Job Title: Fullstack JavaScript Engineer — GraphQL Focus

Location: Remote – Open to Latin America (must have at least partial overlap with UK business hours)

Type of Contract: Full-Time | Remote

Salary Range: Competitive Salary + Performance Bonus (based on experience)

Language Requirements: Advanced English (written and verbal)

Our client is seeking a skilled Fullstack JavaScript Engineer with strong, hands-on GraphQL experience to join their growing team. You will play a key role in designing and developing GraphQL APIs while building scalable frontend applications with React, TypeScript, and Node.js. Your work will directly impact the scalability, performance, and delivery of premium digital fitness products used by global brands and communities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain GraphQL APIs and backend services using Node.js and TypeScript, with a strong focus on API architecture, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Develop and integrate GraphQL schemas, queries, mutations, resolvers, and data models to support product requirements and frontend applications.
  • Build and maintain scalable frontend applications using React and TypeScript, consuming GraphQL APIs effectively.
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy full-stack features from concept through production release.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate requirements into high-quality technical solutions.
  • Take ownership of features, releases, and production deployments in a fast-paced, product-focused environment.
  • Use AI-powered development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and similar technologies to improve development productivity, testing, debugging, and documentation.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with GraphQL in production environments; this is the most important requirement for the role.
  • Solid understanding of GraphQL architecture, including schemas, queries, mutations, resolvers, and API design.
  • Strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript for backend/API development.
  • Strong experience with React and TypeScript for frontend development.
  • Experience designing, building, integrating, and consuming GraphQL APIs in full-stack applications.
  • Solid understanding of SQL databases, particularly PostgreSQL, and how they integrate with GraphQL-based applications.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed product and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GraphQL performance optimization, schema design, and API scalability.
  • Experience with GraphQL tooling and ecosystem technologies.
  • Knowledge of Prisma ORM.
  • Experience with Tailwind CSS.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest.
  • Experience building and maintaining component libraries using Storybook.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized application environments.
  • Previous experience working on SaaS, fitness, health-tech, or consumer-facing platforms.
  • Experience working in distributed remote teams.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar technologies.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Quarterly company performance bonuses.
  • Access to fitness products, subscriptions, and wellness resources.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Unlimited paid time off.
  • Family-friendly leave policies.
  • Team events, company gatherings, and hobby allowance.

Company Values

  • Everyone is a leader.
  • Always improving.
  • Grit to deliver.
  • The team is greater than the individual.

Important Note

This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be able to maintain at least partial overlap with UK working hours to support collaboration across product, engineering, and business teams.

How You’ll Make an Impact
