raw.description:
Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

Job Description

The Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) & Contract Administrator role will act as the primary business owner of the CLM platform, responsible

for day-to-day administration, configuration, and continuous improvement. This role will ensure compliance with Contract Management processes

and the Amcor Commercial Contract Guide, maintain an accurate and auditable contract repository, design and maintain CLM workflows, approval

flows, dashboards, KPIs, along with develop AI-enabled playbooks and clause guidance in collaboration with Legal and Commercial Operation


Accountabilities

1. Own the day‑to‑day administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of the CLM platform, acting as the primary business owner.

· Design, build, and maintain CLM workflows, including intake forms, contract workflows, approval flows, and

escalation paths aligned with business requirements and risk thresholds.

· Configure and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPIs to provide visibility into contract status, risk exposure, cycle

times, and obligations.

· Coordinate user access, roles, permissions, and onboarding for the Contract Management tools.


2. Develop, maintain, and enhance AI‑enabled playbooks, clause guidance, and fallback positions in collaboration with Commercial Operations and Legal.

· Implement and manage obligation tracking, alerts, and post‑signature compliance monitoring within the CLM system.


3. Maintain an accurate, complete, and auditable contract repository and database

· Support compliance with Contract Management process for GRPS contracts


4. Act as the first point of contact for CLM system issues, enhancements, and change requests, coordinating with IT and vendors as needed.

· Support continuous improvement projects as needed.


Qualifications/Requirements

Formal Qualifications and Experience

· Degree in law, IT or relevant experience.

· Experience administering or working with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) systems; hands‑on experience.

configuring workflows, approvals, dashboards, or reports is strongly preferred.

· Comfort working with structured processes, risk frameworks, and technology‑enabled business solutions.

· Proficient with Microsoft Office, Outlook and CRM systems (SAP and/or Oracle experience is preferred).

· Experience with Ironclad and/or SFDC highly valuable.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities/Behaviours

· Organized individual with capability of managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

· Collaborative work style, team player and strategic relationship builder.

· Ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality.

· Strong attention to detail, process orientation, and commitment to data accuracy.


Other information

GRPS is running an implementation of a modern, global CLM platform (Ironclad) which enables a significant expansion of contract management capabilities beyond tool consolidation. These include advanced reporting and analytics, integrated obligation tracking to proactively identify and address commercial leakage, AI-enabled playbooks and clause guidance, risk-based workflows, and enhanced post-signature compliance monitoring. While these capabilities materially strengthen governance, visibility, and value realization, they also introduce an ongoing operational workload that cannot be absorbed

within the current resourcing model. To ensure these new capabilities are effectively implemented, governed, and scaled this role has become essential to the success of the project.


Our Expectations

We expect our people to be guided by The Amcor Way and demonstrate our Values every day to enable the business to win. We are winning when:

  • Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high-performing Amcor team
  • Our customers grow and prosper from Amcor’s quality, service, and innovation
  • Our investors benefit from Amcor’s consistent growth and superior returns
  • The environment is better off because of Amcor’s leadership and products

Equal Opportunity Employer/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Veterans/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity

Amcor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you would like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant under the law, please click on the "Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal" Poster. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please call 224-313-7000 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

E-Verify

We verify the identity and employment authorization of individuals hired for employment in the United States.

Benefits

When you join Amcor, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits and compensation package that includes:

  • Medical, dental and vision plans

  • Flexible time off, starting at 80 hours paid time per year for full-time salaried employees

  • Company-paid holidays starting at 8 days per year and may vary by location

  • Wellbeing program & Employee Assistance Program

  • Health Savings Account/Flexible Spending Account

  • Life insurance, AD&D, short-term & long-term disability, and voluntary benefits

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Retirement Savings Plan with company match

  • Tuition Reimbursement (dependent upon approval)

  • Discretionary annual bonus program (initial eligibility dependent upon hire date)

raw.description:
LEAD THUMBNAIL DESIGNER | REMOTE

To Apply:

ROLE:

As the Lead Thumbnail Designer at Knwn Local, you'll build and develop a team of 5-10+ thumbnail designers who create scroll-stopping visuals that drive channel growth for America's top real estate leaders. This is a player-coach leadership role where you'll spend 60-80% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 20-40% hands-on designing complex projects.

You'll own design quality standards, team development, and creative operations across the agency, partnering closely with Pod Managers, Creative Director, and leadership on strategic initiatives. Your success is measured not by how many thumbnails you design, but by how well your team performs, grows, and delivers results that drive client success.

This role is perfect for someone who loves developing designers as much as designing itself - someone who gets energized by building systems, coaching talent, and multiplying impact through others. If you want to stay purely hands-on without management responsibilities, this isn't the right fit.

Apply now:

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership & Development (50-70% of role)

  • Directly manage 5-8 thumbnail designers conducting weekly 1-on-1s focused on skill development and performance
  • Lead bi-weekly team design reviews with constructive feedback and best practice sharing
  • Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new designer hires
  • Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria for design team members
  • Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework
  • Handle hiring (writing JDs, screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making offers)
  • Build 2-5+ year relationships with designers through proactive retention and engagement strategies
  • Conduct skip-level meetings with junior designers to assess team health and identify early warning signs

Creative Excellence & Standards (20-30% of role)

  • Design 15-30 high-impact thumbnails per month for VIP clients and complex projects
  • Own and evolve agency-wide creative quality standards, brand guidelines, and style guides
  • Establish QA processes that maintain 90%+ first-approval rate across all designers
  • Lead A/B testing strategy and performance analysis across the entire client portfolio
  • Serve as final creative approval for all thumbnails before client delivery
  • Drive creative innovation through monthly experimentation initiatives and "Good Flops"
  • Create and maintain design team's template library and asset management systems

Strategic Collaboration & Systems (10-20% of role)

  • Partner with Pod Managers on client strategy and creative direction for key accounts
  • Present creative strategy and performance insights in Monthly Client Strategy Calls with clients
  • Collaborate with executive leadership on agency-wide creative vision and initiatives
  • Build scalable workflows, capacity planning, and resource allocation systems
  • Create performance dashboards tracking team metrics (CTR, approval rates, turnaround times)
  • Document best practices, SOPs, and knowledge base for the design function
  • Contribute to quarterly planning, annual strategy summits, and company OKRs

REQUIREMENTS:

Leadership & Design Experience

  • 6+ years of professional design experience with 2+ years managing creative teams
  • Proven track record leading, developing, and scaling design teams of 5+ people
  • Minimum 3+ years creating high-performing YouTube thumbnails with proven CTR results
  • Experience hiring designers, conducting performance reviews, and managing accountability
  • Portfolio showcasing thumbnails that contributed to channel growth (include CTR data)
  • Comfortable with difficult conversations (performance issues, firing, conflict resolution)

Technical & Strategic Skills

  • Expert-level proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma (portfolio required)
  • Deep understanding of YouTube algorithms, CTR optimization, and viewer psychology
  • Data-driven approach with ability to interpret analytics and translate into design strategy
  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies, performance analysis, and optimization
  • Strong presentation skills for client-facing strategy calls and executive meetings
  • Understanding of creative team economics (capacity planning, resourcing, budgeting)

Communication & Cultural Leadership

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication for feedback, presentations, and documentation
  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality
  • Extreme Ownership - Takes full accountability for team results; never blames or makes excuses
  • Beyond Excellence - Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to exceed them
  • Proactive Curiosity - Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of needs
  • Mission Focus - Obsesses about client success and team development over personal recognition

RESULTS:

Team Performance

  • Your design team consistently maintains 90%+ first-approval rate across all designers
  • Designer retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression
  • New designers productive at 80% capacity within 30-60 days through your training systems
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter
  • Team operates at 80-90% capacity utilization - productive output without burnout

Quality & Impact

  • Zero client escalations due to design quality issues or missed deadlines from your team
  • Agency-wide thumbnail CTR averages 5-10% (significantly above platform benchmarks)
  • 95%+ on-time delivery rate across your entire team's project portfolio
  • Design workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency-wide
  • Your team generates innovative thumbnail strategies that drive agency-wide adoption

Strategic Leadership

  • Design function viewed as strategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership
  • Successfully contribute to client strategy with design insights that drive performance
  • Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for design quality and communication
  • At least 1-2 designers promoted or advancement-ready annually due to your mentorship
  • Leadership views design as a strategic differentiator, not just an execution function

COMPENSATION & GROWTH:

Salary & Benefits

  • Starting Range: $42,000 - $72,000 USD/year depending on experience and team size managed
  • Fully Remote
  • Flexible Time Off policy & Company Wide Holiday Breaks (we trust you to manage your time and energy)
  • Professional development budget for courses, plugins, and creative tools
  • Potential Health Insurance Reimbursement (after 60-90 day trial period options including Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Potential to earn Monthly wellness allowance
  • Potential to earn Home office stipend for equipment and software
  • Leadership development program
  • Access to industry-leading tools, plugins, and AI-assisted editing software
  • Clear career progression with transparent promotion criteria

Performance Metrics You'll Own

  • Team Performance: Design Quality Score, First-Approval Rate (90%+), CTR performance
  • Team Development: Skill progression, promotion readiness, retention rate (85%+)
  • Operational Excellence: Capacity utilization (80-90%), on-time delivery (95%+)
  • Strategic Impact: Innovation initiatives, process improvements, client satisfaction (>4.5/5)

LOCATION:

  • 100% Remote

WHO WE ARE:

Knwn Local helps America's top real estate leaders (ranked by Wall Street Journal Real Trends) attract more clients and grow their brands through strategic YouTube presence. Our clients manage $30M-$300M+ real estate teams and brokerages.

We're scaling from 55+ to 200+ channels with the mission of helping agents dominate their local markets through long-form video content that builds trust and authority.

Our Core Values: Extreme Ownership, Beyond Excellence, Proactive Curiosity, Mission Focus

MAKE SURE YOU'RE COMFORTABLE WITH:

  • Remote team leadership (building culture and managing performance without in-person oversight)
  • Rigorous hiring process including portfolio review, leadership case study, design test, and interviews
  • 90-day paid trial period with clear success metrics and transparent evaluation
  • Player-coach expectations (10-30% IC work even as you grow the team)
  • High-growth environment (processes evolve, priorities shift, resilience required)
  • Accountability culture (measured on results with clear metrics and transparent feedback)

TO APPLY:

If you're ready to build a world-class design team and multiply your creative impact 10x by developing others, please submit:

FYI we primarily look at those who apply using the above site

Pay 42k - 72k+ USD a year

raw.description:
Our Solution Expert team plays a key role in supporting strategic customers in RUN phase, by acting as trusted advisors on complex use cases. Working closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success, they analyze advanced client needs, challenge existing setups, and translate requirements into scalable solutions within the 360Learning platform.
You will manage a portfolio of customers throughout their lifecycle to drive product adoption and deliver tailored solutions beyond standard product capabilities.
These large and strategic accounts have already deployed the platform and have a strong level of autonomy. They rely on your technical and functional expertise to lead complex integrations (APIs, flat files, third-party tools), redesign platform architecture, run solution audits, and provide high-level recommendations to maximize business impact and long-term value.

Within 1 month, you will:

  • Become a Trello expert through our onboarding process
  • Understand our product offering through training
  • Master our platform and be able to support clients on basics requests through ticketing

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Own your portfolio of 10 enterprise clients & leading up to 30 active projects simultaneously
  • Start to answer questions coming from your portfolio of clients
  • Support the Customer Success partner on functional and technical questions
  • Successfully implement integration (SSO, third-party tools), deliver technical expertise on how to integrate their learning platform to their technical environment & troubleshooting

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Be able to pitch the value of the 360Learning platform
  • Develop repeatable and scalable processes to improve project quality and delivery
  • Support Strategic customers all along their contract from an expertise standpoint
  • Deliver Professional Services to our existing customers base

Within 12 months, you will:

  • Onboard another Solution Expert
  • Contribute to our knowledge base to share best practices and lessons learned
  • Work with our partner ecosystem to strengthen the services proposed to our clients
  • Deliver platform audits to clients
  • Deliver professional services proposed in our Professional Service catalogue

The Skill Set

  • 3 years of professional consulting experience, preferably in a customer facing role (Level 2 or 3 support agents, Technical consultant, Technical Account Manager)
  • Previous deployment experience of SaaS products, ideally HR related
  • Project management skills
  • Good understanding and experience working with APIs, SSO configuration & troubleshooting
  • Solution-oriented, client-first mindset in everything you do
  • Ability to adapt to your audience, flexibility in tackling a conversation with highly technical stakeholders, and reducing complexity to more common terms with less technical stakeholders
  • Organized, structured, rational, analytical, able to manage priorities across multiple customer implementations
  • Full professional proficiency in French, English, and German
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here:

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈

  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.

  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠

  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍

  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: & find out more about the teams, product and processes 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

The Interview Process

  • Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with a Solution Expert
  • Case Study Meeting with 2 Solution Expert Coach and a Solution Expert
  • Clarification Meeting with our Head of Professional Services
  • Culture Fit Meeting with our Chief Human Resources Officer
  • Offer !
    • ⇾ Get ready using our Knowledge Base:

Who We Are

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.
360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!
